b20270a9.title: Application Consultant-AWS Cloud Migration
b20270a9.description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As an Application Consultant for Cloud Migration, you will act as a consultant for Cloud Migration Solution delivery, utilizing software architecture fundamentals and assets, tools, and the garage method for cloud. You will leverage your expertise in migration solutions for hybrid cloud platforms to drive successful migrations.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Deliver Migration Solutions: Design and implement migration strategies for hybrid cloud platforms, utilizing rehost, refactor, rearchitect, replatform, and containerization techniques to ensure seamless transitions.
* Map Components to AWS Services: Identify and map existing components and functionalities to AWS-specific services, considering the advantages and disadvantages of each service to inform migration decisions.
* Execute Migration Strategy: Carry out migration plans, ensuring successful architecture implementation and meeting client needs.
* Collaborate on Migration Tools: Work with stakeholders to identify and utilize effective migration tools, considering network requirements, application, database, and integration component migration pathways.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Cloud Migration Solution Delivery: Exposure to delivering cloud migration solutions, leveraging software architecture fundamentals, assets, and tools, such as the garage method for cloud.
* Hybrid Cloud Platform Expertise: Experience working with hybrid cloud platforms, including designing and implementing migration strategies, and executing architecture implementation.
* AWS Service Mapping: Exposure to mapping existing components and functionalities to AWS-specific services, with a deep understanding of the advantages and disadvantages of related AWS Services.
* Migration Tool Proficiency: Experience working with migration tools, including understanding migration network requirements, application, database, and integration component migration pathways.
* Containerization and Migration Techniques: Exposure to rehost, refactor, rearchitect, replatform, and containerization techniques for seamless transitions.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Hybrid Cloud Platform Knowledge: Experience working with hybrid cloud platforms, including designing and implementing migration strategies, is beneficial. Understanding of architecture implementation and migration tool utilization is also valuable.
* Advanced AWS Service Understanding: Exposure to mapping existing components and functionalities to AWS-specific services, with a deep understanding of the advantages and disadvantages of related AWS Services, is preferred.
* Containerization Technique Familiarity: Familiarity with rehost, refactor, rearchitect, replatform, and containerization techniques for seamless transitions is desirable.

0b973532.title: MS - IT Infra/Cloud -  Senior Associate Service Level Manager- operate
0b973532.description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a Senior Associate Release & Deployment Manager in IT Infra/Cloud, you will play a pivotal role in managing and optimizing cloud infrastructure and services to enable seamless operations and availability for clients. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will focus on designing and implementing robust, secure IT systems that support business operations, confirming the smooth functioning of networks, servers, and data centers to optimize performance and minimize downtime.
  
  
As a Senior Associate, you will build meaningful client connections and learn how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions. Embracing increased ambiguity, you will be comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, using these moments as opportunities to grow.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be responsible for monitoring, troubleshooting, and implementing industry-leading practices for cloud-based systems. Your ability to respond effectively to diverse perspectives and use a broad range of tools and methodologies will be crucial in generating new ideas and solving problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Managing and optimizing cloud infrastructure to support seamless operations and minimize downtime
* Implementing industry-leading practices for cloud-based systems to enhance performance and availability
* Monitoring and troubleshooting cloud services to identify and resolve issues promptly
* Designing and deploying cloud infrastructure architecture to meet client needs and business objectives
* Collaborating with teams to develop and execute cloud migration strategies
* Utilizing Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure for cloud administration and service management
* Conducting performance optimization and compliance checks for cloud environments
* Providing technical consultation and support for cloud operations and infrastructure management
* Building and maintaining client relationships to understand and anticipate their cloud service requirements
* Mentoring junior team members in cloud operations and infrastructure management techniques

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 4 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Utilizing Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform
* Managing Cloud Infrastructure Architecture Design and Optimization
* Demonstrating proficiency in Cloud Migration and Operations
* Navigating complex Cloud Compliance and Service Delivery challenges
* Excelling in Infrastructure Management and Performance Monitoring
* Embracing change and fostering intellectual curiosity
* Developing self-awareness and enhancing strengths through reflection

22b75ce1.title: Associate Technical Consultant-Cloud - Java,Microservices,Kafka,Nosql
22b75ce1.description:
**Scope**

* Core responsibilities to include Architecting and designing (along with counterparts and distinguished Architects) a ground up cloud native (we use Azure) SaaS product in Order management and micro-fulfillment
* The team currently comprises of 60+ global associates across US, India (COE) and UK and is expected to grow rapidly. The incumbent will need to have leadership qualities to also mentor junior and mid-level software associates in our team

**Our Current Technical Environment**

* Software: Java, Springboot, React, Gradle, GIT, Hibernate, Rest API, OAuth
* Application Architecture: Scalable, Resilient, event driven, secure multi-tenant Microservices architecture
* Cloud Architecture: MS Azure (ARM templates, AKS, HD insight, Application gateway, Virtue Networks, Event Hub, Azure AD)
* Frameworks/Others: Kubernetes, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Spark, NOSQL, RDBMS, Springboot, Gradle GIT, Ignite

**What You’ll Do**

* Drive architecture and designs to become simpler, more robust, and more efficient.
* Write and review service descriptions including relevant measures of service quality and drives architecture to deliver on these promises through self-healing, reliable services that require minimum manual intervention.
* Provide early visibility and mitigation to technical challenges through the journey.
* Confidently represents product and portfolio, including vision and functional and technical roadmaps, within the company and, when necessary, to strategic customers

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree (STEM preferred) and minimum 0-1 years of experience in Software development; ideally a candidate that has started as a Software Engineer
* Strong programming experience and background in Enterprise Java, Springboot, Gradle, GIT, Hibernate, Rest API, OAuth
* Demonstrable experience designing, building deploying and maintenance of enterprise cloud solutions (Azure)
* Demonstrable experience with microservices based architecture on Cloud at scale.
* Experience with implementation of Event driven architecture using Kafka, Spark or similar technologies
* Hands-on development skills along with architecture/design experience; should not have moved away from software development
* Demonstrable experience, thorough knowledge and interests in Cloud native architecture, Distributed micro-services, Multi-tenant SaaS solution and Cloud Scalability, performance and High availability
* Experience with API management platforms & providing / consuming RESTful APIs
* Experience with varied tools such as Spring Boot, OAuth, REST, GraphQL, Hibernate, NoSQL, RDBMS, Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka.
* Experience with DevOps, Infrastructure as Code and infrastructure automation.

**Our Values**
If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

ef22c9bc.title: Manager Consulting Delivery- Technical Program Manager- DevOps-Cloud Platform Engineering(12+Years)
ef22c9bc.description:
Position Description
  
  
Company Profile:
  
  
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.
  
  
Position: Manager Consulting Delivery- Technical Program Manager- DevOps-Cloud Platform Engineering
  
  
Experience: 12+Years
  
  
Category: Software Development/ Engineering
  
  
Shift: General Shift (Flexibility required for global stakeholder engagements)
  
  
Location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Pune/Mumbai
  
  
Position ID: J1026-0343
  
  
Employment Type: Full Time
  
  
Education Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 12 years of relevant experience.
  
  
Technical Program Manager accountable for delivering the CCOE transformation program: an Operations Control Plane and SaaS operating model for CGI Advantage, serving 50+ State & Local Government clients. The role is AI-first by mandate: the TPM is expected to design, prove, and scale AI-assisted operations across the program. It combines hands-on technical credibility — someone who still builds, prototypes, and reviews code — with large-scale program leadership across engineering, operations, and executive stakeholders, and a demonstrated bias for speed and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Your future duties and responsibilities
  
  

* Plan and run PI cadences: scope, dependencies, capacity, exit criteria, and transparent re-planning across all CCOE workstreams.
* Drive wave-based rollouts (e.g., observability across multi-tenant AKS estates) within client change windows and government compliance constraints.
* Build funding and business cases spanning multiple internal organizations; force decisions through steering with stated cost of delay.
* Referee build-vs-buy and competing-architecture decisions against written criteria; time-box debates and document decisions with revisit conditions.
* Lead vendor evaluation and enterprise contract negotiation for platform tooling — pricing, support SLAs, security and compliance terms.
* Report program outcomes without spin: MTTR, escalation rate, automation coverage, and SLA adherence.
* Partner with operations leadership on workforce transition: reskilling, redeployment, and adoption of new tooling and workflows — including AI literacy and safe, governed use of AI tooling.
* Own the AI roadmap for operations: LLM-assisted triage, RAG over runbooks, tickets, and telemetry, agentic remediation, and AI-assisted engineering workflows — from prototype through production with evaluation, guardrails, and cost controls.
* Define AI governance with security and compliance: data residency, PII handling, prompt and output logging, human-in-the-loop gates, and model/version change control for government clients.
* Drive urgency through time-boxed delivery: bias to 2–4 week proof points, kill or scale decisions on evidence, and visible burn-down of the riskiest unknowns first.

**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
Must to Have Skills:
  
  

* Azure platform depth (primary cloud): AKS at multi-tenant production scale, Azure networking (VNet, Private Link, Front Door, App Gateway), Entra ID, Azure Policy and landing-zone/Well-Architected design, autoscaling, tenancy isolation, and cost management (FinOps, reservations, tagging, chargeback).
* Azure services breadth: Azure Monitor and Log Analytics (KQL), Managed Grafana, Key Vault, Storage, API Management, Functions and Container Apps, Service Bus/Event Hubs, Azure SQL, and DevOps/GitHub integration.
* Observability: Understanding of OpenTelemetry-based stacks (traces, logs, metrics), sampling and retention economics, and alert tuning at scale.
* CI/CD and GitOps: Understanding of GitHub Actions, Argo CD, incremental builds, and policy-as-code gates (OPA, Kyverno, Conftest) with container signing and scanning.
* Infrastructure-as-code and configuration management: Terraform/OpenTofu, Ansible, and configuration-in Git with drift detection.
* Identity and security: Understanding of SSO, RBAC, and JIT access patterns (Entra ID, Keycloak); secrets and certificate lifecycle automation (Key Vault, cert-manager, ACME).
* AI and GenAI fundamentals: LLM capabilities and limits, prompt engineering, context engineering, structured output and function/tool calling, fine-tuning vs. prompting trade-offs, token and inference cost management, and latency/quality trade-offs.
* RAG and knowledge systems: chunking and embedding strategies, vector and hybrid search (Azure AI Search, pgvector, or equivalent), re-ranking, grounding and citation, retrieval evaluation, and mitigation of hallucination and data leakage.
* Agentic and AI-assisted operations: multi-step agents and orchestration frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent), Model Context Protocol (MCP) style tool integration, and evaluation and observability of AI systems (eval harnesses, golden datasets, tracing, drift monitoring).
* Understanding of Azure AI stack: Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, model deployment and quota management, private networking for AI endpoints, content safety, and responsible-AI controls.
* Hands-on engineering ability: comfortable in Python (and/or Go or TypeScript), Git-based workflows, SQL/KQL, and shipping working prototypes without waiting for a team to be assigned.
* Program tooling fluency: PI and agile planning at scale, RICE or equivalent prioritization, and dependency and risk management.

Good-to-Have Skills:
  
  

* 12+ years in technology, including 5+ years running multi-team technical programs (8–15 initiatives) as a TechPM, program lead, or platform delivery lead.
* Operations transformation: moving support and operations organizations from reactive firefighting to problem management and SRE practices.
* FOSS-biased platform strategy with explicit commercial buy triggers; hands-on vendor MSA negotiation.
* Developer platform delivery (e.g., Backstage) and production delivery of AI-assisted operations — LLM assisted triage, RAG-backed knowledge and runbook assistants, and self-healing workflows with measured deflection.
* Azure certifications or equivalent demonstrated depth (e.g., AZ-305 Solutions Architect, AZ-400 DevOps Engineer, AI-102 Azure AI Engineer).
* Active hands-on builder — personal projects, open-source contributions, or side builds using AI tooling; genuinely passionate about development and fast iteration.
* Presenting to executive leadership: funding asks, program reviews, and candid at-risk status narratives.

**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**
Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…
  
  
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.
  
  
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.
  
  
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.
  
  
That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.
  
  
Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

Role Overview Looking for an experienced Technical Lead – Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM who will be responsible for providing technical leadership across Dynamics 365 CRM implementations, enhancements, integrations and application maintenance services. The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Dataverse, Dynamics 365 CE, Plugins, C#, JavaScript, Power Automate, Web API and integrations, along with the ability to lead a team of developers and work closely with functional consultants, architects and customer stakeholders. Key Responsibilities 1. Technical Leadership • Lead the technical design and development of Dynamics 365 CRM solutions. • Translate functional requirements into scalable and maintainable technical solutions. • Review technical designs, coding standards and development approaches. • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to CRM developers. • Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards. • Identify technical risks, dependencies and mitigation plans. • Participate in architecture and design discussions with Solution Architects. 2. Dynamics 365 CRM Development • Develop and customize Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE/CRM solutions. • Strong hands-on development experience with: o Dataverse o Plugins using C# o Custom Workflow Activities o JavaScript/TypeScript o Dynamics 365 Web API o Power Automate o Business Rules o Custom Actions / Custom APIs o Business Process Flows o Security Roles and Teams • Design and implement custom tables, relationships, forms, views and business logic. • Develop reusable and performance-optimized CRM components. 3. AMS / Production Support • Provide technical leadership for Dynamics 365 CRM application support. • Troubleshoot P1/P2/P3 incidents and complex production issues. • Perform technical RCA and define permanent corrective actions. • Coordinate with Microsoft, infrastructure, integration and third-party teams when required. • Ensure adherence to SLA and customer support commitments. • Participate in technical governance and customer review meetings. 8. Team Management • Lead and mentor a team of CRM developers. • Conduct technical knowledge-sharing sessions. • Allocate technical tasks and review progress. • Support estimation and effort planning. • Review developer deliverables and ensure technical quality. • Act as the technical escalation point for the development team. Soft Skills • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills. • Ability to independently drive technical discussions. • Good documentation skills. • Ability to work with distributed teams. • Strong ownership and accountability. • Ability to mentor junior and senior developers. Microsoft Dynamics, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Security Model, Microsoft Dataverse

With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

b19b7c04.title: Hardware Engineering Program Manager
b19b7c04.description:
At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.

This role leads integrated new product introduction (NPI) programs for complex hardware platforms from architecture through production release. Working across Hardware Engineering, Firmware, Software, FPGA, Systems, Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and external partners, the role drives cross-functional execution, technical risk management, compliance, and production readiness. The position combines strong program leadership with hands-on hardware understanding to resolve issues, manage phase gates, and maintain alignment across engineering and operational teams. This work enables Gigamon to deliver reliable, compliant, high-performance networking and security products on schedule.

### **What you’ll do:**

* Own the integrated NPI program plan, including milestones, critical path, dependencies, resources, risks, issues, decisions, and phase-gate readiness from architecture through production release.
* Drive engineering validation test (EVT), design validation test (DVT), production validation test (PVT), pilot production, and mass-production readiness, including entry and exit criteria, build plans, go/no-go reviews, recovery plans, and executive reporting.
* Coordinate board spins, rework, engineering changes, defect triage, root-cause analysis, retesting, and closure of critical hardware issues.
* Serve as the primary liaison across Hardware Engineering, Firmware, Software, FPGA, Systems, Mechanical, Thermal, Reliability, Quality, Manufacturing, Product Management, Supply Chain, and Product Operations.
* Lead requirements reviews, integration reviews, technical risk reviews, supplier checkpoints, build-readiness reviews, phase gates, and leadership updates.
* Manage JDM and OEM partners, contract manufacturers, PCB assembly suppliers, component suppliers, test laboratories, and other external technology providers.
* Track BOM and AVL readiness, long-lead components, capacity, tooling, manufacturing test, DFM/DFA, design-for-test, yield, quality issues, corrective actions, and production ramp readiness.
* Manage external hardware vendors, technical service agreements, tool subscriptions, certification vendors, and license renewals.
* Drive configuration management and controlled change processes for schematics, PCB layouts, FPGA releases, BOMs, mechanical drawings, firmware, test procedures, manufacturing documentation, and released products.
* Provide concise status reporting on milestone health, critical path, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, compliance status, and recovery actions.
* Own the hardware compliance plan, certification schedule, regulatory dependencies, and release evidence for applicable markets.
* Coordinate pre-compliance assessments, formal testing, test-house activities, failure analysis, retesting, corrective actions, declarations of conformity, regulatory marks, certificates, and technical documentation.
* Maintain traceability between compliance requirements, design evidence, test results, deviations, waivers, certification decisions, and engineering changes.
* Assess the compliance and certification impact of PCB revisions, component substitutions, enclosure changes, firmware updates, and manufacturing-site changes.
* Partner with Product Security and Engineering on applicable hardware security requirements, including secure boot, root of trust, key storage, debug-port controls, component provenance, and SBOM inputs.
* Apply knowledge of applicable EMI/EMC, product safety, environmental, and materials compliance requirements throughout the product lifecycle.

### **What you’ve done:**

* Earned a bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent hardware or engineering program management experience may be considered.
* Built significant experience managing complex hardware development programs, preferably for networking, telecommunications, cloud infrastructure, or security products.
* Demonstrated understanding of the complete hardware lifecycle, including architecture, schematic and PCB development, FPGA verification, prototype builds, board bring-up, system integration, qualification, certification, production ramp, and sustaining engineering.
* Gained hands-on hardware lab experience troubleshooting boards and systems with engineering teams and driving issue resolution from observed data.
* Brought up at least one PCB or complex hardware platform from initial power-on through functional validation.
* Developed working knowledge of high-speed interfaces, power delivery, signal integrity, thermal management, chassis design, manufacturing test, reliability, and system validation.
* Coordinated EMI/EMC testing, product safety evaluations, environmental qualification, reliability testing, and regulatory certification.
* Applied expert program management practices, including integrated planning, risk and issue management, dependency tracking, change control, stakeholder management, and executive communication.
* Delivered complex programs against challenging schedule, quality, cost, and performance targets in a large organization.

### **Who you are:**

* A technically grounded program leader who can connect engineering details with business and product outcomes.
* A collaborative partner who builds alignment across cross-functional teams, suppliers, manufacturing organizations, and executive stakeholders.
* An effective influencer who leads teams without direct authority and drives accountability through clear decisions, ownership, and follow-through.
* A structured and disciplined operator who maintains visibility into critical paths, dependencies, risks, compliance requirements, and recovery actions.
* A hands-on problem solver who is comfortable working in the hardware lab, interpreting technical data, and guiding issues to closure.
* A clear and concise communicator who can translate complex technical and program information into actionable updates for varied audiences.

62052c04.title: Product Delivery Manager - Infrastructure Platforms
62052c04.description:
**Job Description**
Shape the future of product delivery while crafting solutions that enhance and optimize customer experiences across
**Job Scheduling, Orchestration, and Search platforms**
(e.g., AutoSys/Control-M, Temporal/Airflow, Elastic/OpenSearch). As a Product Delivery Manager (Engineering Delivery Manager) in Infrastructure & Platform under Corporate Technology, you will lead end-to-end delivery, manage dependencies, and liaise with stakeholders to enable successful implementations in an expedient and organized way—while strengthening governance, transparency, and operational readiness through disciplined planning, tooling, and risk management practices
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Leads end-to-end product delivery processes including intake, dependency management, release management, product operationalization, delivery feasibility decision-making, and product performance reporting.
* Owns quarterly planning to produce an execution-ready, decision-quality Book of Work (scope, priorities, resourcing assumptions, timelines, risks, and dependencies) for the product line.
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineering Managers to define high-level deliverables and milestones per product area; translates them into clear EPICs and well-defined Jira stories to support execution tracking, reporting, and governance.
* Drives predictable roadmap execution by maintaining clear priorities, tracking progress against milestones, and proactively surfacing risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies with mitigation options and escalation paths.
* Partners with Engineering, Product, SRE, and key stakeholders to maintain a single, consolidated view of delivery + risk + priorities (“ONE Book of Work”) and reduce duplication across workstreams.
* Coordinates audit readiness activities relevant to the products (pre-audit preparation, mock RFIs, response orchestration), and partners with risk/control stakeholders to plan and deliver remediation within sprint/quarterly commitments.
* Establishes and maintains strong stakeholder communication rhythms, with standardized reporting and actionable decision logging.
* Identifies and implements continuous improvement opportunities, including automation of delivery-management workflows (status generation, RAID hygiene, reporting rollups, dependency tracking) leveraging AI to reduce manual effort and increase transparency.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* 5+ years of experience (or equivalent expertise) in product delivery or a relevant domain area and overall 12+ years of experience.
* Strong understanding of delivery and a proven track record of implementing continuous improvement processes.
* Experience in product or platform-wide release management, in addition to deployment processes and strategies.
* Proven ability to manage timelines and dependencies while monitoring blockers, ensuring adequate resourcing, and liaising with stakeholders and functional partners.
* Demonstrated ability to understand horizontal program requirements and collaborate with engineering, product and program stakeholders for delivery.
* Executive-level communication skills suitable for stakeholder management, including clear escalation, decision framing, and delivery accountability.
* Experience leveraging AI frameworks for handling some or all of these activities

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Proficient knowledge of the product development life cycle, design, and data analytics.

a35f8ec0.title: Technical Program Manager - IoT
a35f8ec0.description:
**Quin | About the Company**
Quin is a safety-technology company. Our technology ships inside products from leading global brands across motorcycling, cycling, sport and industrial PPE. We are becoming the primary source of real-world crash data across every protective gear category, and we build the data tools that manufacturers and testing bodies use to engineer safer products and standards. Our engineering and product centre is in Hyderabad, with helmet testing labs in Hyderabad and London, and teams across India, the UK and the US.
  
  
**Why this role exists**
Every Quin release can involve hardware, firmware, mobile, cloud and design, often for several products at once. We are looking for a technical delivery leader who sees the whole system, and coordinates cross-functionally efficiently. This Technical Program Manager must understand the technology well enough to challenge an estimate, read a firmware or API change and know what it breaks downstream, and be able to automate coordination wherever possible, so the team spends more time building with clarity.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**Cross-functional delivery**

* Own the delivery plan across embedded, mobile, backend, web, QA and design, from requirement to release.
* Map dependencies, surface risks early and drive decisions to close them.

**Release management**

* Own release cadence and release readiness across multiple apps, firmware versions and cloud services.
* Work with QA on release sanity, regression coverage and go/no-go calls.
* Keep release notes, versioning and rollback plans clean and current.

**Escalations and clarity**

* Be the single named owner for delivery escalations. Bring leadership a clear recommendation, not just a problem.
* Give leadership one honest view of status, risk and dates, without anyone having to chase.

**Documentation and knowledge**

* Make documentation part of how work gets done: decision records, runbooks, release notes and handovers.
* Build a shared, searchable knowledge base so no system depends on human memory.
* Run it with access controls that protect confidential and product data.

**Lightweight, automated process**

* Set up planning, estimation and tracking that is lean and useful.
* Use automation to cut down status meetings, manual reporting and copy-paste work.
* Support team growth, and champion initiatives to ensure people and achievements are celebrated at Quin.

**Must-haves**

* 5+ years in software or hardware engineering delivery, with 2+ as a TPM or delivery lead for connected products.
* An engineering background, or equivalent hands-on depth. You can hold your own in an architecture review.
* Shipped products that span at least two of: firmware/embedded, mobile apps, cloud backend.
* Release management across multiple products or customers at once.
* Strong written communication skills, without AI polish. Your docs and updates are short, clear and trusted.
* You use AI tools daily to plan, track, write and automate, but can work without it.

**Strong pluses**

* IoT, BLE devices, wearables or consumer hardware launches.
* Able to excel in fast-paced, high ownership environment.
* Built documentation or knowledge-management systems that people used.
* Experience with test automation, CI/CD and release pipelines.

**How We Work**
We are a small team of senior doers. We hire people who move fast and own their work, not people who manage others to do the work. You will own delivery outcomes, not just track them.
  
  
**Our hiring process & AI use**
Use AI tools freely on any exercise. The only rule:
**declare what you used and be ready to defend every decision live.**
The recruitment process will involve at least 2 interviews, and 1 assignment and live debrief.

cb48c7f9.title: Hardware Engineering Program Manager
cb48c7f9.description:
**Description**
At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. Certified as a Great Place to Work, we offer a deep observability pipeline that efficiently delivers network-derived intelligence to cloud, security, and observability tools. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.
  
  
This role leads integrated new product introduction (NPI) programs for complex hardware platforms from architecture through production release. Working across Hardware Engineering, Firmware, Software, FPGA, Systems, Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and external partners, the role drives cross-functional execution, technical risk management, compliance, and production readiness. The position combines strong program leadership with hands-on hardware understanding to resolve issues, manage phase gates, and maintain alignment across engineering and operational teams. This work enables Gigamon to deliver reliable, compliant, high-performance networking and security products on schedule.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the integrated NPI program plan, including milestones, critical path, dependencies, resources, risks, issues, decisions, and phase-gate readiness from architecture through production release.
* Drive engineering validation test (EVT), design validation test (DVT), production validation test (PVT), pilot production, and mass-production readiness, including entry and exit criteria, build plans, go/no-go reviews, recovery plans, and executive reporting.
* Coordinate board spins, rework, engineering changes, defect triage, root-cause analysis, retesting, and closure of critical hardware issues.
* Serve as the primary liaison across Hardware Engineering, Firmware, Software, FPGA, Systems, Mechanical, Thermal, Reliability, Quality, Manufacturing, Product Management, Supply Chain, and Product Operations.
* Lead requirements reviews, integration reviews, technical risk reviews, supplier checkpoints, build-readiness reviews, phase gates, and leadership updates.
* Manage JDM and OEM partners, contract manufacturers, PCB assembly suppliers, component suppliers, test laboratories, and other external technology providers.
* Track BOM and AVL readiness, long-lead components, capacity, tooling, manufacturing test, DFM/DFA, design-for-test, yield, quality issues, corrective actions, and production ramp readiness.
* Manage external hardware vendors, technical service agreements, tool subscriptions, certification vendors, and license renewals.
* Drive configuration management and controlled change processes for schematics, PCB layouts, FPGA releases, BOMs, mechanical drawings, firmware, test procedures, manufacturing documentation, and released products.
* Provide concise status reporting on milestone health, critical path, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, compliance status, and recovery actions.
* Own the hardware compliance plan, certification schedule, regulatory dependencies, and release evidence for applicable markets.
* Coordinate pre-compliance assessments, formal testing, test-house activities, failure analysis, retesting, corrective actions, declarations of conformity, regulatory marks, certificates, and technical documentation.
* Maintain traceability between compliance requirements, design evidence, test results, deviations, waivers, certification decisions, and engineering changes.
* Assess the compliance and certification impact of PCB revisions, component substitutions, enclosure changes, firmware updates, and manufacturing-site changes.
* Partner with Product Security and Engineering on applicable hardware security requirements, including secure boot, root of trust, key storage, debug-port controls, component provenance, and SBOM inputs.
* Apply knowledge of applicable EMI/EMC, product safety, environmental, and materials compliance requirements throughout the product lifecycle.

**What You’ve Done**

* Earned a bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent hardware or engineering program management experience may be considered.
* Built significant experience managing complex hardware development programs, preferably for networking, telecommunications, cloud infrastructure, or security products.
* Demonstrated understanding of the complete hardware lifecycle, including architecture, schematic and PCB development, FPGA verification, prototype builds, board bring-up, system integration, qualification, certification, production ramp, and sustaining engineering.
* Gained hands-on hardware lab experience troubleshooting boards and systems with engineering teams and driving issue resolution from observed data.
* Brought up at least one PCB or complex hardware platform from initial power-on through functional validation.
* Developed working knowledge of high-speed interfaces, power delivery, signal integrity, thermal management, chassis design, manufacturing test, reliability, and system validation.
* Coordinated EMI/EMC testing, product safety evaluations, environmental qualification, reliability testing, and regulatory certification.
* Applied expert program management practices, including integrated planning, risk and issue management, dependency tracking, change control, stakeholder management, and executive communication.
* Delivered complex programs against challenging schedule, quality, cost, and performance targets in a large organization.

**Who You Are**

* A technically grounded program leader who can connect engineering details with business and product outcomes.
* A collaborative partner who builds alignment across cross-functional teams, suppliers, manufacturing organizations, and executive stakeholders.
* An effective influencer who leads teams without direct authority and drives accountability through clear decisions, ownership, and follow-through.
* A structured and disciplined operator who maintains visibility into critical paths, dependencies, risks, compliance requirements, and recovery actions.
* A hands-on problem solver who is comfortable working in the hardware lab, interpreting technical data, and guiding issues to closure.
* A clear and concise communicator who can translate complex technical and program information into actionable updates for varied audiences.

As an equal opportunity employer, all applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, age, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, and/or local law. For more information, please refer to Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal.

**Platform:** Microsoft Dynamics 365

fb48b4a1.title: Presales Consultant - BIGFIX HCL SOFTWARE
fb48b4a1.description:
**Job :**
Presales Consultant – BigFix & IT Operations

**Location:**
India (Remote / Hybrid – Major Hubs: Bengaluru, Mumbai, NCR, Pune, Hyderabad)

**Experience Level:**
12+ years of relevant IT experience (Minimum 5+ years in a technical Presales / Solution Architect role)

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a highly strategic and technically adept
**Presales Architect**
specializing in
**HCL BigFix**
and broader
**Enterprise IT Infrastructure management**
to drive our growth in the Indian enterprise market.

In this role, you will serve as the trusted technical advisor to our enterprise clients, partners, and internal sales teams. You will design, present, and demonstrate robust architectures that solve complex challenges across endpoint management, security compliance, IT service workflows, and cross-platform infrastructure visibility.

**What is BigFix?**

Our
*BigFix*
business is one of the recognized leaders in endpoint management and security with fully automated discovery, management, patch and remediation, across on premise and cloud devices regardless of their location or connectivity. It is the trusted endpoint solution for 100,000,000 endpoints in 150 countries.

The individual will perform in a technical pre-sales and post sales role for Big Fix with Clients. They will be expected to attend meetings with potential Clients to determine the technical and business requirements and ensuring that all necessary information is collated prior to producing a solution. They will be the accountable for providing the technical solutions in a professional manner and to agreed timeframes. They will be expected to deliver short-term BigFix professional services if required. They will work continuously on the long term success of the account in concert with other HCL employees and partners.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Solution Design & Architecture:**
  Architect enterprise-scale HCL BigFix topologies (including relays, servers, and database scaling) integrated with broader IT management ecosystems for large-scale Indian enterprises and global delivery hubs.
* **Technical Presales Leadership:**
  Lead technical discovery sessions, deliver high-impact product demonstrations, and manage complex Proof of Concepts (PoCs) to prove business value to C-level executives (CIOs, CISOs) and technical stakeholders.
* **RFP & Proposal Management:**
  Own the technical response for RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs, translating intricate technical specifications into clear, value-driven business solutions.
* **Cross-Domain Integration:**
  Design technical blueprints that seamlessly connect endpoint data with wider IT service, operations, identity, and monitoring frameworks.
* **Market & Partner Enablement:**
  Collaborated with system integrators (SIs) and channel partners across India to enable them technically and scale pipeline velocity.

**Key Technical Domain Expertise**

* **Unified Endpoint Management (UEM):**
  Deep technical command of HCL BigFix (Lifecycle, Patch, Inventory) across diverse OS environments (Windows, macOS, Linux, AIX). Proven ability to solve complex patching, software distribution, and asset lifecycle management challenges at scale.
* **ITSM & ITOM Integration:**
  Strong experience aligning endpoint data with
  **IT Service Management (ITSM)**
  and
  **IT Operations Management (ITOM)**
  platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, BMC Helix, Jira Service Management). Expertise in streamlining configuration management databases (CMDB) data accuracy and automating incident/change triggers based on endpoint states.
* **Security Compliance & Vulnerability Management:**
  Proficient in designing automated compliance architectures using frameworks like CIS Benchmarks, NIST, or ISO 27001. Expert knowledge in leveraging BigFix Compliance to rapidly detect, remediate, and report configuration drift and zero-day vulnerabilities.
* **Identity & Access Management (IAM):**
  Solid understanding of how endpoint compliance data feeds into
  **IAM**
  and Zero Trust architectures. Experience positioning secure access solutions, directory services integration (AD, Azure AD/Entra ID), and ensuring only compliant, authenticated devices gain network access.
* **Observability & Monitoring:**
  Familiarity with integrating endpoint telemetry into enterprise
  **Observability**
  pipelines (e.g., Splunk, Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic) to provide proactive insights into digital employee experience (DEX) and infrastructure health.

**Qualifications & Skills Required**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* **Technical Certifications:**
  HCL BigFix professional certifications are highly desirable. Certifications in ITIL v4, AWS/Azure Architecture, CISSP, or relevant IAM/Observability platforms are a massive plus.
* **Industry Experience:**
  Prior experience selling into large Indian verticals (BFSI, Manufacturing, Telecom, Healthcare, or major Global Capability Centres/GCCs).
* **Communication Style:**
  Exceptional presentation and articulation skills in English, with the unique ability to bridge the gap between highly technical engineers and business-focused executives.
* **Travel:**
  Willingness to travel across India for strategic client meetings and industry events as required

**Core KPPs:**

* To mentor, organize, report for, and lead team of Technical Advisor peers
* To attend meetings with potential Clients to determine technical and business requirements and ensuring that all necessary information is collated prior to producing a solution
* Provide technical solutions in a professional manner and to agreed timeframes
* Create and confidently deliver technical presentations internally and externally
* Deliver training on solutions and provide product support to channel partners and internal stakeholders
* Create internal design configuration documentation including network diagrams with technical explanations
* Work with Product Management and Engineering to provide feedback on issues with current products and provide input around new products
* Builds productive relationships internally and externally, fostering teamwork by keeping colleagues updated on activities
* Perform technical development for solutions as part of a design and development framework
* Able to understand business drivers and risks involved to the customer
* Sell technical solutions to the customer with professionalism and enthusiasm
* Provide accurate and timely management information, to include - activity reports, bid reviews, project forecasts, KPI’s
* Create technical demos and enable product sellers.

**About HCL Software**

HCL Software is the software business of HCLTech. Products span digital experience, data, automation and security. The eXperience portfolio includes Unica+ along with Commerce, Digital Experience and Volt MX.

*HCL Software is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.*

47982277.title: AI Presales Solutions Architect
47982277.description:
**Job Description**

**AI Presales Solutions Architect — Agentic AI, India & APAC**

*Company: Intellect Design Arena | Platform: Purple Fabric (Agentic AI) |Region: India & APAC*

**About the Role**

Purple Fabric is Intellect's agentic AI platform, and this role exists to make it the default choice for enterprise buyers across India and APAC. That means owning the regional GTM motion end to end — but it also means being in the room when a CTO or lead architect starts asking how the agent orchestration actually works, how the platform handles evaluation and guardrails, or how it integrates into their existing stack. This role does not work as a pure narrative-and-relationships play. The person needs enough hands-on fluency in agentic AI and LLM-based systems to hold that conversation directly, then walk straight into the CXO's office and reframe the same substance as a transformation story.

**This is the core differentiator for this hire**
: equal credibility with a business sponsor and a technical evaluator, in the same deal, often the same week.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Market Penetration & Strategic Evangelism**

* **Establish Platform Preference:**
  Align GTM motions with local market priorities through leadership discussions and cross-functional collaboration.
* **Executive & Technical Engagement:**
  Lead conversations with priority prospects across both the CXO layer and the technical evaluation team — shaping the transformation agenda with sponsors while fielding architecture, security, and integration questions from their engineering and platform teams without needing an SME to translate.
* **Brand Visibility:**
  Drive thought leadership and regional presence through masterclasses, roundtables, and industry events — speaking with authority on agentic AI, not just platform positioning.
* **Cross-Functional Alignment:**
  Partner with Sales, Product, and Delivery to ensure consistent messaging, solution articulation, and unified GTM alignment across all client and partner interactions.

**Partner-Led GTM Acceleration & Ecosystem Enablement**

* **Scale Partner Initiatives:**
  Drive partner-led GTM initiatives to expand regional adoption and platform positioning.
* **Playbook Development:**
  Build structured partner GTM playbooks covering positioning, use cases, deployment models, and industry narratives — grounded in real agentic AI implementation patterns, not generic templates.
* **Partner Enablement:**
  Lead enablement programs, including technical onboarding, deployment orientation post-VDA sign-off, and bootcamps focused on opportunity identification and value mapping.
* **Success Frameworks:**
  Establish partner success metrics to improve adoption consistency, integrating domain and technical SMEs into engagements for contextual depth.

**Client Adoption & Strategic Engagement Excellence**

* **Engagement Frameworks:**
  Drive structured engagement frameworks to accelerate enterprise adoption and long-term platform positioning.
* **Strategic Roadmaps:**
  Lead maturity-aligned engagement sessions and build account-level roadmaps tied to client transformation priorities.
* **Adoption Journeys:**
  Own the client journey from discovery through PoC scoping and technical validation, ensuring both executive alignment and engineering sign-off before deals progress.

**Sales Excellence, Strategic Assets & Team Enablement**

* **Empower the Field:**
  Equip regional teams with winning narratives and the technical grounding to defend them under questioning.
* **Asset Management:**
  Maintain and evolve the Purple Fabric Sales Kit — pitch decks, demos, architecture diagrams, case studies, and industry narratives.
* **Sales Readiness:**
  Run enablement sessions that build both pitching confidence and technical objection handling — architecture, data privacy, model behavior, integration effort.
* **Feedback Loops:**
  Implement post-engagement client feedback mechanisms to continuously refine assets and messaging.

**Adoption Acceleration & Strategic Continuity Governance**

* **Value Discovery:**
  Lead structured bootcamps and demonstration sessions to identify relevant agentic AI use cases, providing roadmap clarity beyond the first meeting.
* **Execution Guidance:**
  Deliver prioritized use-case recommendations and phased execution guidance, integrating SMEs for contextual depth.
* **Strategic Oversight:**
  Maintain visibility of engagement progression across priority accounts, driving the transition from exploratory discussion to PoC or implementation.

**GTM Capability & Team Leadership**

* **Build the Function:**
  Build, scale, and lead a regional GTM function that is technically credible, not just relationship-driven.
* **Operational Rhythm:**
  Define role charters, engagement models, and operating rhythm for the regional GTM team.
* **Mentorship & Readiness:**
  Coach team members to handle executive-facing and technical-facing conversations with equal confidence; build structured onboarding for new hires.
* **Culture & Discipline:**
  Set narrative and technical communication standards, and foster cross-functional collaboration.

**Must-Have**

* **10+ years**
  in Go-To-Market, presales, or solution consulting for AI/ML-based products or platforms — this is a hard requirement. Generic enterprise software or B2B SaaS presales without an AI/data platform component will not meet the bar.
* **Technical depth in AI systems:**
  working knowledge of how LLM-based and agentic systems are actually built and evaluated — agent orchestration, RAG, prompt/context engineering, model evaluation and guardrails, and how these integrate into enterprise architectures (APIs, data pipelines, security/compliance layers).
* **Dual-mode fluency:**
  demonstrated ability to run a CXO transformation conversation and a technical deep-dive with an engineering or architecture team in the same sales cycle, without relying on a technical SME to carry the room.
* **Executive presence:**
  proven track record engaging C-level executives and guiding enterprise digital transformation conversations.

**Strongly Preferred**

* **Agentic AI presales experience specifically**
  — having sold, positioned, or architected agentic (multi-agent, autonomous workflow) AI platforms, not just traditional ML or analytics tools.
* Direct exposure to enterprise buyers evaluating agentic AI in regulated industries (BFSI, insurance, wealth management) across India or APAC.

**Also Important**

* **Regional Expertise:**
  Deep understanding of the enterprise technology landscape across India and the broader APAC region.
* **Partner Ecosystems:**
  Experience building and scaling partner-led GTM motions and enablement programs.
* **Leadership:**
  Demonstrated ability to build, mentor, and scale high-performing, cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

You will help shape competitive solutions that support major sales opportunities while improving commercial outcomes and supplier value. Working across sales, operations, customers, partners, and internal solution teams, you will coordinate stakeholders from opportunity through successful deployment. The role requires both strategic thinking and hands-on execution, particularly in high-pressure, complex sales environments. You will influence commercial decisions, negotiate with suppliers, and design value-added approaches that improve margins and delivery outcomes. Fully remote and aligned with UK office hours, the role offers the opportunity to work across international markets and complex, multi-partner IT environments.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Develop commercially competitive solutions and negotiated supplier costs that support successful bids, improve margins, and strengthen overall commercial performance.
* Act as a key interface between Sales, Operations, customers, prospects, partners, and internal solution teams throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Lead and coordinate complex and major bids, managing the formal bid communication process and bringing together virtual bid teams to maximize opportunities for success.

* Coordinate transition solutions involving IT outsourcing, desktop and hardware deployment, service transition, global audits, logistics, procurement, and stock management.
* Manage multiple solutions and projects simultaneously, including international engagements delivered across several countries and through multiple partners.
* Drive continuous improvement by aligning internal and supplier capabilities, identifying operational synergies, and developing effective ways of working.
* Influence stakeholders and suppliers without relying on formal authority, resolving conflicts and building mutually beneficial outcomes.
* Monitor external market developments, technology trends, and changes in the IT services landscape to inform solution design and supplier strategies.
* Delegate responsibilities effectively and maintain clear ownership across virtual and matrix-managed teams.
* Ensure solutions are aligned with customer expectations, operational capabilities, commercial objectives, and the technologies underpinning the service portfolio.

**Requirements**

* Relevant bachelor's degree or equivalent professional qualification; MCIPS qualification is advantageous.
* Demonstrated experience in influencing, negotiation, and delivering solutions within matrix-managed environments.
* Proven experience in the IT field services industry, particularly hardware remedial services and related service delivery environments.
* Experience across several relevant disciplines, including bid management, customer account management, operational management, service management, supplier management, transition management, and project management.
* Previous experience working within complex, multicultural, international, and matrix-managed organizations.

* Strong results orientation, with a sense of urgency and the resilience to overcome obstacles and deliver against challenging objectives.
* Strategic and visionary thinking, with the ability to develop supplier-selection and management strategies and translate them into clear, actionable business objectives.
* Strong execution skills and a track record of driving continuous improvement across supplier and internal relationships.
* Excellent influencing and negotiation capabilities, including the ability to gain stakeholder support, manage conflict, and create mutually beneficial outcomes.
* Strong understanding of IT outsourcing, desktop and hardware deployment, service transition, logistics, procurement, stock management, and global audit activities.
* Experience managing multiple solutions or projects concurrently across different countries, customers, and delivery partners.
* Broad understanding of IT technologies, market trends, product developments, and the technology underpinning managed IT services.
* Strong analytical ability and a consultative approach to solution development and stakeholder engagement.
* Proven ability to build and manage relationships with customers, suppliers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Highly effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication style to different audiences and organizational levels.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite.
* Ability to delegate tasks, responsibilities, and decision-making authority effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to influence business processes without relying on hierarchical authority.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to operate effectively in a complex matrix environment.
* Personable, collaborative, proactive, commercially aware, and comfortable operating under pressure.
* Willingness and ability to work UK office hours while based remotely in India.

**Benefits**

* Full-time employment with a working schedule aligned to UK office hours.
* Opportunity to work on complex, international IT solutions and major commercial bids.
* Exposure to global customers, suppliers, partners, and multi-country service delivery environments.

* Opportunity to develop expertise across IT outsourcing, field services, procurement, transition management, and solution architecture.

Pakt is an AI-native hiring platform that helps organizations accelerate recruitment through AI-powered sourcing, candidate screening, interviews, assessments, and hiring automation. Its AI Recruiter, Scout, manages the process from job brief to qualified shortlist, handling sourcing, structured AI interviews, skills and culture fit evaluations, and ranked, human-reviewed shortlists. For teams that prefer to run hiring directly, Pakt offers a complete AI-powered Applicant Tracking System (ATS) with tools for job posting, candidate management, interview scheduling, collaboration, and offer management. Day-to-day responsibilities include advising clients on best practices, guiding implementation and integration activities, troubleshooting complex issues, and ensuring performance, scalability, security, and reliability of deployed solutions. ea143a70.title: Solution Consultant - Direct Sale
ea143a70.description:
**Role Overview**

As a Solution Architect/ Consultant for Direct Sales, you will be the ultimate technical bridge between SIONIQ's advanced capabilities and major jewelry enterprise clients. You will not just pitch softwareyou will map complex business workflows (metal weight controls, wastage tracking, stone attributes, and layout-based approvals) into elegant architectural solutions using SIONIQ JOS.

The defining requirement of this role is your ability to conduct highly technical, end-to-end, deep-dive demonstrations that command the respect of traditional promoters, CFOs, operations heads, and IT directors across the retail, wholesale, and manufacturing jewelry segments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Deep-Dive Technical Demonstrations: Deliver meticulous, master-level product demonstrations tailored to jewelry industry stakeholders, simulating real-life scenarios like gold-to-diamond swapping, karigar wastage calculations, RFID inventory tracking, and multi-branch accounting.
* Solution Architecture Design: Map out the client’s existing technical environment and design the future-state blueprint using SIONIQ JOS, outlining data migrations, custom workflows, and API integrations with accounting or e-commerce platforms.
* Direct Sales Collaboration: Partner closely with Account Executives on strategic enterprise deals, steering the technical qualification process and validating compliance, security, and infrastructure requirements.
* Discovery & Workflow Assessment: Conduct on-site technical discoveries at client manufacturing units, wholesale vaults, and retail showrooms to uncover hidden operational inefficiencies or product leaks.
* Proof of Concept (PoC) Ownership: Build and lead tailored PoCs for premier prospects, proving the concrete business value, speed, and real-time inventory control capabilities of the platform.
* RFIs & Technical Documentation: Own the technical responses for Requests for Proposals/Information (RFPs/RFIs) and author comprehensive architectural solution blueprints for handoff to the implementation team.

**Required Skills & Experience**

Domain Expertise (Non-Negotiable)

* Jewelry Value Chain Mastery: Comprehensive understanding of jewelry operational mechanics, including pure metal vs. alloy calculations, making charges, stone sieve sizes, hallmark compliance, and live bullion rate feeds.
* Segment Familiarity: Deep appreciation for the distinct operational differences separating Manufacturers (line planning, raw materials), Wholesalers (B2B credit, approval memos), and Retailers (barcoding, loyalty, multi-store exchange policies).

Technical & Sales Acumen

* Solution Architecture: Minimum of 3–6 years of experience as a Sales Engineer, Solution Architect, or Lead Implementation Consultant for Enterprise ERP/POS software.
* Demonstration Mastery: Exceptional capability to showcase complex enterprise logic under pressure, addressing edge-case workflow adjustments effortlessly on screen.
* Tech Stack Fluency: Comfortable explaining SaaS vs. cloud vs. on-premise deployments, relational databases (SQL Server/PostgreSQL), and modern Web/Mobile API structures.
* C-Suite Communication: Polished verbal and written communication style capable of shifting fluidly from a granular technical talk with an IT Director to a high-level ROI conversation with a jewelry brand founder.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience deploying or selling regional or global jewelry ERP systems (e.g., customized SAP modules, legacy jewelry software).
* Direct experience handling hardware integrations common to the jewelry industry, such as RFID tags, security scanners, or smart precision scales.

2263c01d.title: Technology Solution Engineer
2263c01d.description:
**Role Overview**

The Technology Solution Engineer works with business and technology stakeholders to shape technical solutions, then builds them. This is a deliberately broad, hands-on role that combines consultative solution design with real delivery across the enterprise technology platforms.

  

At this level, the Technology Solution Engineer owns solutions end to end. The role runs requirement workshops directly with business stakeholders, authors the design, makes independent technical decisions, and leads the build through to operational handover. Work spans the full platform estate rather than a single technology, and includes reviewing the work of others and mentoring less experienced engineers.

The platforms in scope include cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services, integration, automation, APIs, containers, and web hosting. Platforms are run both as internal products and as managed services, so the role carries accountability for how solutions run as well as how they are built.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Consulting and Design**

* Engage business functions and technology stakeholders to understand objectives, constraints, and the problem behind the request.

* Facilitate requirement and design workshops, and translate outcomes into clear technical solution designs.

* Produce options analyses with honest trade-offs across cost, risk, delivery time, supportability, and strategic fit.

* Author solution designs, architecture decision records, interface definitions, and non-functional requirements.

**Cross-Platform Solution Delivery**

* Design and build solutions spanning cloud infrastructure, integration, APIs, automation, containers, and web hosting.

* Provision and configure platform services using Terraform, Ansible, and the approved Infrastructure as Code toolchain.

* Develop supporting automation and tooling in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or another appropriate language.

* Lead technical delivery of solutions involving multiple platforms and multiple contributing teams.

**Service Transition and Operational Ownership**

* Ensure solutions meet operational readiness criteria before production release, including monitoring, alerting, runbooks, backup, and recovery.

* Instrument solutions for observability using Datadog, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Cribl, or Observe.

* Own investigation and resolution of complex issues, root-cause analysis, and preventive corrective actions.

**Security, Compliance, and Risk**

* Design and build to enterprise security standards, applying identity and access patterns based on Entra ID, Okta, OAuth2, and least privilege.

* Manage secrets and certificates through HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk, and cloud-native key services.

* Identify and articulate technical risk, technical debt, and exceptions, with practical remediation proposals.

**Technical Craft and Engineering Practices**

* Write clean, tested, peer-reviewed code and configuration, managed in version control with trunk-based practices.

* Review the work of other engineers and raise the standard of design and implementation across the team.

* Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate design, development, testing, and documentation, applying appropriate review and technical judgement.

**Collaboration and Ways of Working**

* Work within an agile team with a shared backlog, defined customers, and service-level objectives.

* Act as a credible technical partner to business stakeholders, explaining trade-offs in plain language.

* Coordinate across platform, cloud, integration, web, security, architecture, and operations teams.

* Mentor less experienced engineers through pairing, review, and structured feedback.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Demonstrated capability in solution engineering, platform engineering, or technical delivery

* Strong hands-on experience with at least one major public cloud, with practical exposure to a second.

* Proven ability to own a solution end to end, from requirements through design, build, and operational handover.

* Practical Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform, and configuration management with Ansible.

* Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, JavaScript, or Java.

* Working knowledge across several of: containers and Kubernetes, integration and APIs, web hosting, networking, and identity.

* Demonstrated ability to run workshops and engage business stakeholders directly.

* Clear written and verbal communication in English, including presenting designs to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Preferred**

* Experience mentoring engineers or leading small technical workstreams.

* Experience with OpenShift, Backstage or another developer portal, and GitOps tooling.

* Experience with integration or API platforms such as MuleSoft, Kafka, Solace, or Kong.

* Experience with web and application server technologies such as IIS, Tomcat, Apache, or Nginx.

* Experience delivering within a validated, GxP, or otherwise regulated environment, including awareness of data-protection obligations such as GDPR.

* Certifications such as AWS or Azure professional or expert level, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, ITIL, or an agile qualification.

* A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related discipline.

**Core Competencies**

* Consultative mindset with genuine interest in the business problem

* Strong technical judgement and architectural awareness

* Breadth across technologies combined with useful depth in several

* Clear communication and stakeholder credibility

* Bias toward reuse, standardisation, and simplification

* Ownership and accountability from design through to operation

* Willingness to mentor and raise the standard around them

**Measures of Success**

* Solutions delivered to agreed scope, quality, cost, and timeline

* Increased reuse of approved patterns and platform capabilities, and reduced bespoke build

* Reduced defects, rework, and post-implementation incidents

* Improved availability and supportability of delivered solutions

* Stakeholder satisfaction and repeat demand from business functions

* Reduced security findings and audit exceptions in delivered solutions

* Demonstrable growth in the engineers mentored
