04dc4c3e.description:
**Position Overview**

We are looking for a Cloud Service Delivery & Assurance Manager to lead cloud implementation, transition, and operational assurance across Saksham Cloud/RHOSO and public cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI. The role will coordinate with customers, architects, engineering, operations, and security teams to ensure cloud services are delivered as per scope, timelines, quality, security, and SLA commitments.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Cloud Service Delivery

* Lead end-to-end cloud service delivery across RHOSO (RedHat OpenStack On OpenShift), AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI.
* Translate customer and business requirements into executable delivery plans.
* Manage implementation schedules, milestones, risks, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Coordinate provisioning, configuration, migration, testing, go-live, and handover activities.
* Ensure delivery meets agreed scope, quality, security, SLA, and operational readiness requirements.

2. Customer & Stakeholder Management

* Act as the primary customer-facing interface for cloud implementation and service transition.
* Conduct progress reviews, technical discussions, and service review meetings.
* Communicate status, risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation plans clearly.
* Manage escalations and coordinate internal teams for timely resolution.

3. Engineering & Technical Coordination

* Coordinate with architects, platform engineers, DevOps, network, security, storage, and operations teams.
* Convert approved solution architecture into delivery activities and track technical dependencies.
* Validate implementation readiness and manage deviations from approved scope or design.
* Facilitate technical problem-solving between customer and internal teams.

4. Cloud Platform Scope

* RHOSO, OpenStack, OpenShift/Kubernetes, and hybrid-cloud environments.
* AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI cloud services and delivery models.
* Compute, storage, networking, IAM, security, monitoring, backup, DC/DR, migration, and automation/IaC concepts.

5. Service Assurance & Operational Readiness

* Ensure delivered services meet availability, performance, security, capacity, and SLA expectations.
* Validate operational readiness, service acceptance, documentation, and production handover.
* Coordinate monitoring, incident, problem, change, backup, and support processes.
* Drive RCA, corrective actions, and continuous improvement for service reliability.

6. Reporting & Management Communication

* Prepare delivery dashboards, service reports, and management updates.
* Track KPIs, SLAs, risks, milestones, issues, and service health indicators.
* Escalate critical issues with impact analysis and recommended actions.

Required Skills & Experience

* 5+ years in cloud infrastructure, service delivery, infrastructure operations, or technical project delivery.
* Strong knowledge of AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI, with exposure to OpenStack, RHOSO, OpenShift, or Kubernetes.
* Understanding of compute, storage, networking, IAM, security, monitoring, backup, and cloud operations.
* Good understanding of ITIL processes including incident, problem, change, SLA, and service acceptance.

Preferred Certifications

* Relevant certification in AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, Red Hat/OpenShift, Kubernetes, OpenStack, ITIL, PMP, or PRINCE2 is preferred.

78ac9ed0.title: Delivery Manager
78ac9ed0.description:
**Technical Delivery Manager**
Who We Are
  
  
Bidgely (which means "electricity" in Hindi) is an AI-powered SaaS company accelerating a clean energy future by enabling energy companies and consumers to make data-driven energy-related decisions. Ranked #7 in Applied AI on Fast Company’s list of Most Innovative Companies in the World, Bidgely is putting customers at the center of the clean energy future.
  
  
What We Do
  
  
Powered by our unique patented technology, Bidgely's UtilityAI™ Platform transforms multiple dimensions of customer data—such as energy consumption, demographics, and interactions—into deeply accurate and actionable consumer energy insights. We leverage these insights to empower each customer with personalized recommendations tailored to their individual personality and lifestyle, usage attributes, behavioral patterns, purchase propensity, and beyond.
  
  
How We Do It
  
  
From a distributed energy resources (DER) and grid edge perspective, Bidgely advances smart meter innovation with data-driven solutions for solar PVs, electric vehicle (EV) detection, EV behavioral load shifting and managed charging, energy theft, short-term load forecasting, grid analytics, and time-of-use (TOU) rate designs. Bidgely’s UtilityAI™ platform provides deep visibility into generation and consumption for better peak load shaping and grid planning and delivers targeted recommendations for new value-added products and services.
  
  
For more information, please visit:
  
  

* Website: www.bidgely.com
* Blog: bidgely.com/blog

**About The Role**
We are looking for a Delivery Manager to head a cross-functional team in implementing and configuring our product solutions for enterprise-level clients. This role demands extensive technical leadership, people management, and project ownership skills, ensuring thorough quality checks and leading innovative approaches (e.g., GenAI, automation) to streamline delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with internal engineering, R&D, QA, and support teams, receiving high-level, outcome-based requirements from our Technical Program Managers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Strategic Leadership & Team Management
  
  

* Manage, mentor, and inspire a team of engineers and project leads, ensuring a high standard of performance, engagement, and professional growth.
* Develop and optimize team structures, resource planning, and talent development strategies to scale delivery capabilities.
* Foster a culture that values ownership, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.

Senior-Level Project Delivery
  
  

* Translate complex, outcome-driven requirements from Technical Program Managers into comprehensive project roadmaps and execution plans.
* Oversee multiple, concurrent implementation projects—coordinating internal teams to ensure timely, budget-conscious, and high-quality releases.
* Communicate progress, risks, and mitigation strategies effectively with senior stakeholders and leadership.

Quality Assurance & Release Management
  
  

* Establish and uphold rigorous quality controls, encompassing functionality, data integrity, performance, and user acceptance criteria.
* Work with QA resources (matrixed or dedicated) to align on testing strategies, automation frameworks, and release protocols.
* Drive continuous improvement in release readiness processes and performance metrics.

Technical Innovation & Problem-Solving
  
  

* Provide deep-dive technical guidance, from code-level debugging to data-level analysis, empowering the team to solve complex challenges.
* Collaborate with R&D to integrate new product features seamlessly, ensuring reliable configurations for enterprise-scale use cases.
* Champion the introduction and application of cutting-edge tools—including GenAI—to automate, optimize, and simplify implementation workflows.

Process Optimization & Automation
  
  

* Identify and implement strategic improvements to reduce manual effort, boost delivery speed, and maintain consistent quality across projects.
* Promote documentation, best practices, and standardized procedures to drive efficiency and scalability.
* Leverage metrics, analytics, and user feedback to iterate on processes and evolve best-in-class delivery methodologies.

**Requirements**
Experience & Education
  
  

* 7+ years of experience in software delivery, implementation, or technical program/project management, with progressive leadership responsibilities.
* Proven track record of managing large-scale, cross-functional projects in fast-paced or enterprise environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; an advanced degree (MBA, MS) is a plus.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* Demonstrated proficiency in software configuration, integration APIs, data pipelines, debugging, and system performance optimization.
* Hands-on experience tackling complex technical issues at both application and data levels.
* Familiarity with automation frameworks, DevOps practices, and emerging technologies (e.g., GenAI).

Leadership & Communication
  
  

* Strong background in leading and mentoring high-performing technical teams, including architects, senior developers, and QA leads.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of interfacing with executive-level audiences.
* Adept at guiding cross-functional groups toward common goals and managing change in a dynamic environment.

Domain Knowledge
  
  

* Experience in the energy or utilities sector is beneficial, but not required.
* Ability to adapt rapidly to evolving industry trends and new technologies.

Equal Opportunity Statement
  
  
Bidgely is an equal-opportunity employer. We are serious about and embrace diversity and equal opportunity. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills to build a better future and a better workforce.

2bfe2861.title: ADMS Delivery Manager
2bfe2861.description:
******Job Description Summary******   As an ADMS Delivery Manager you will be a pivotal contributor to the successful delivery of ADMS Series 3 (DMS / OMS / SCADA) implementations and upgrades for electric utility customers across the MENAT and APAC regions. You will own the technical delivery of assigned projects across the full post-sales lifecycle - from requirements and design through configuration, network model build, testing, cutover, go-live and hypercare - working directly with customers and with cross-functional GE Vernova teams.  
This role is dedicated to the Distribution GSL Series 3 delivery portfolio and operates under the direction of the regional ADMS Lead in MENAT as well as the HTC GDC leader . It combines deep ADMS technical expertise with customer-facing delivery ownership, and contributes to building regional capability and reducing reliance on single points of expertise. Requiring a high level of operational and technical judgement, the expectation for this role is moderate autonomy. **Job Description** 

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* **Project Delivery Ownership**
  + Act as the technical delivery lead for assigned ADMS Series 3 implementations, upgrades and installed-base engagements across MENAT and APAC.
  + Own technical deliverables throughout the entire project lifecycle - requirements, functional and technical design, system configuration, distribution network model (DNAF) build and validation, integration, FAT/SAT, cutover, go-live and hypercare - ensuring projects stay on track in terms of budget, time and customer expectations.
  + Plan and track delivery activities, effort and milestones for assigned projects; report progress, risks, issues and change requests to the regional Delivery Manager and project stakeholders.
  + Help to lay out proper staffing to cover all regional ADMS S3 deliveries and coordinate GE Vernova, HTC and partner resources assigned to the project to ensure all projects are successful.
  + Manage defects, change requests and technical actions through GE Vernova project tracking tools, maintaining accurate and auditable delivery records.
* **Client Collaboration**
  + Serve as the primary technical point of contact for the customer on assigned projects, explaining difficult or sensitive information and working to build consensus.
  + Work closely with clients to understand their unique needs and develop tailored delivery strategies through site assessments and workshops.
  + Make standard recommendations on workflow, application, interface, reports, testing and data uploads to customers during the implementation process.
  + Ensure go-live readiness and provide support, including post-live checkups, to guarantee customer satisfaction.
  + Travel to customer sites in the regions as required by project phase, including extended on-site presence during testing, cutover and go-live windows.
* **Technical Expertise and Installed Base Support**
  + Provide hands-on technical support and troubleshooting across the ADMS Series 3 stack (Habitat / SCADA, DMS applications, OMS / Enterprise OMS, DNAF and system interfaces), including production issue resolution for installed-base customers.
  + Support upgrade planning and execution for the regional ADMS S3 installed base, including version assessments, configuration re-verification and migration activities.
  + Contribute to solution design, sizing and effort estimation for change orders and new opportunities, supporting the regional sales and bid teams as required.
* **Leadership and Mentorship**
  + Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience; mentor regional engineers and support structured knowledge transfer to build redundancy and reduce reliance on a small number of senior SMEs.
  + Ability to work across all GEV silos - Product, Support, Sales, HTC and delivery partners - with a OneTeam mentality.
  + Ability to grow and mentor staff, understanding that not everyone learns and grows the same way.
  + Develop persuasion skills required to influence others on topics within field.
* **Best Practice and Quality Assurance**
  + Develop specialized knowledge in your discipline and serve as a best practice / quality resource for the regional ADMS team.
  + Stay abreast of the latest technical developments in ADMS Series 3 and the GridOS platform, and contribute to delivery standards, runbooks and reusable assets.
  + Ensure delivery excellence within your area of responsibility.
* **Decision-Making and Problem Solving**
  + Use judgment to make decisions or solve moderately complex tasks or problems in areas of delivery, technology or engineering.
  + Take a new perspective on existing solutions and use technical experience and expertise for data analysis to support recommendations.
  + Utilize multiple internal and limited external sources outside of your own function to arrive at decisions.
* **Market Awareness and Integration**
  + Possess in-depth knowledge of best practices and understand how your area integrates with others.
  + Have a working knowledge of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market.

**Required Qualifications**

9538c538.title: Program Manager - Technology
9538c538.description:
* Full-time

**Company Description**
-----------------------

AbhiBus is a leading online bus-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators - including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3.5 lakh (350,000+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.

AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms - ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The Role**

We are looking for a Technology Program Manager who can drive complex, cross-functional technology initiatives from problem definition to execution and delivery.  
  
This is not a traditional Scrum Master / Agile Project Manager role.  
  
You will work in an environment where requirements evolve, priorities change, teams may not be co-located, and there isn't always a well-defined process or single owner for every dependency.  
  
Your job will be to bring clarity, structure and momentum to these situations.  
  
You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations and external technology partners to ensure that complex initiatives move forward and eventually reach production.

**What You Will Do**

* Drive end-to-end technology programs — translate high-level objectives into clear plans, milestones, dependencies and execution paths.
* Navigate complex technical dependencies across multiple engineering teams, services, platforms and third-party systems.
* Work closely with engineering leads to understand architecture, APIs, data flows, system dependencies and technical constraints well enough to identify execution risks early.
* Identify the critical path for programs and continuously remove blockers that could impact delivery.
* Coordinate execution across distributed and non-co-located teams, ensuring alignment without relying purely on formal processes.
* Bring structure to ambiguous problems — figure out what needs to happen, who needs to be involved and how we get from where we are today to the desired outcome.
* Identify risks, dependencies and decisions proactively rather than waiting for issues to surface.
* Facilitate discussions between teams when there are conflicting priorities, unclear ownership or competing technical approaches.
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineering Managers to convert product/business objectives into executable technology plans.
* Maintain program visibility for leadership — what is on track, what is blocked, why it is blocked and what decisions are required.
* Manage execution across multiple parallel workstreams without becoming a task tracker.
* Work with external vendors/partners where technology integration or operational dependencies are involved.
* Establish lightweight processes where needed — but avoid adding process for the sake of process.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3–5 years of experience in Technical Program Management, Product Operations, Engineering Program Management, Technology Consulting or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of software development and technology systems. You don't need to be a coder, but you should be comfortable discussing APIs, databases, services, integrations, data flows, releases and system dependencies with engineers.
* Demonstrated experience driving cross-functional technology initiatives involving multiple teams.
* Strong ability to understand technical dependencies and identify risks before they become delivery problems.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity, changing priorities and incomplete information.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly across teams with different priorities.
* Ability to operate effectively with distributed / geographically dispersed engineering teams.
* Strong ownership mindset — you see a problem through to resolution rather than simply escalating it.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to operate in a high-paced startup environment where processes are evolving continuously.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working in a consumer internet, marketplace, OTA, fintech, mobility or other high-scale technology environment.
* Experience working with microservices, APIs, cloud infrastructure or data platforms.
* Engineering / Computer Science background.
* Experience working with external technology vendors or partners.
* Experience managing programs involving multiple engineering teams and complex integrations.
* Experience in an environment where Product and Engineering operate with high autonomy and lightweight processes.

**What Success Looks Like**

After 6 months, you should be the person teams rely on to answer:

* What exactly are we trying to deliver?
* Which teams and systems are involved?
* What are the critical dependencies?
* What is blocking us?
* Who needs to make a decision?
* What can derail the program?
* What needs to happen next?

**You don't need to create more meetings or more status reports.**  
  
**You need to make complex things happen.**

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

By clicking the link above or any third-party link within this posting, you are leaving this site and going to a third-party website where the third-party website's terms and privacy policy apply

----------------

As Program Manager – AI Solutions Ecosystem & Operations you take identified solutions and use cases and make them real: you run weekly interlocks, hold the portfolio view, and drive each engagement through IT security, legal, procurement and AI governance to deployment and adoption. We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.

be54956a.title: Technical Program Manager - IoT
be54956a.description:
**Quin | About the Company**

Quin is a safety-technology company. Our technology ships inside products from leading global brands across motorcycling, cycling, sport and industrial PPE. We are becoming the primary source of real-world crash data across every protective gear category, and we build the data tools that manufacturers and testing bodies use to engineer safer products and standards. Our engineering and product centre is in Hyderabad, with helmet testing labs in Hyderabad and London, and teams across India, the UK and the US.

**Why this role exists**

Every Quin release can involve hardware, firmware, mobile, cloud and design, often for several products at once. We are looking for a technical delivery leader who sees the whole system, and coordinates cross-functionally efficiently. This Technical Program Manager must understand the technology well enough to challenge an estimate, read a firmware or API change and know what it breaks downstream, and be able to automate coordination wherever possible, so the team spends more time building with clarity.

**What youll own**

**Cross-functional delivery**

* Own the delivery plan across embedded, mobile, backend, web, QA and design, from requirement to release.
* Map dependencies, surface risks early and drive decisions to close them.

**Release management**

* Own release cadence and release readiness across multiple apps, firmware versions and cloud services.
* Work with QA on release sanity, regression coverage and go/no-go calls.
* Keep release notes, versioning and rollback plans clean and current.

**Escalations and clarity**

* Be the single named owner for delivery escalations. Bring leadership a clear recommendation, not just a problem.
* Give leadership one honest view of status, risk and dates, without anyone having to chase.

**Documentation and knowledge**

* Make documentation part of how work gets done: decision records, runbooks, release notes and handovers.
* Build a shared, searchable knowledge base so no system depends on human memory.
* Run it with access controls that protect confidential and product data.

**Lightweight, automated process**

* Set up planning, estimation and tracking that is lean and useful.
* Use automation to cut down status meetings, manual reporting and copy-paste work.
* Support team growth, and champion initiatives to ensure people and achievements are celebrated at Quin.

  
**Must-haves**

* 5+ years in software or hardware engineering delivery, with 2+ as a TPM or delivery lead for connected products.
* An engineering background, or equivalent hands-on depth. You can hold your own in an architecture review.
* Shipped products that span at least two of: firmware/embedded, mobile apps, cloud backend.
* Release management across multiple products or customers at once.
* Strong written communication skills, without AI polish. Your docs and updates are short, clear and trusted.
* You use AI tools daily to plan, track, write and automate, but can work without it.

**Strong pluses**

* IoT, BLE devices, wearables or consumer hardware launches.
* Able to excel in fast-paced, high ownership environment.
* Built documentation or knowledge-management systems that people used.
* Experience with test automation, CI/CD and release pipelines.

**How we work**

We are a small team of senior doers. We hire people who move fast and own their work, not people who manage others to do the work. You will own delivery outcomes, not just track them.

**Our hiring process & AI use**

Use AI tools freely on any exercise. The only rule:  **declare what you used and be ready to defend every decision live.**  The recruitment process will involve at least 2 interviews, and 1 assignment and live debrief.

In this role, you will independently lead cross-domain initiatives-ranging from high-volume platform migrations to regional product launches, remediation projects, and platform onboardings. You will sit within the Servicing organisation, but will align directly with partner product segments outside Servicing, leading cross-functional execution across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Compliance.

This role demands strong stakeholder management, hands-on systems curiosity, program management rigour, pattern recognition, and a passion for process

**What You ll Do**

* **Lead Cross-Domain Initiatives:** Take single-threaded ownership of high-impact, cross-squad projects-including core platform migrations, control rollouts, product launches, and partner integrations.
* **Consult Partners on Platform Integration:** Understand the capabilities, integration flows, and limitations of Wise s Servicing platforms. Guide partner teams through onboarding requirements and help translate business/compliance needs into clear user stories for Implementation Engineers where necessary.
* **Drive Pragmatic, Hands-On Delivery:** Work comfortably at the intersection of product delivery and technical systems. You dont need to review deep technical specifications, but you are comfortable reading architecture diagrams, asking challenging technical questions, running API requests in Postman for testing, and creating dashboards or tables in Looker to track metrics.
* **Manage Operational Transformation Launch Readiness:** Work with Business Operations to ensure product launches are fully supported with operational workflows, queue structures, and agent guidance.
* **Drive Program Management Lifecycle:** Hold the pen on end-to-end program governance-authoring clear program briefs, setting SMART objectives, managing risk logs, tracking delivery milestones, and conducting post-implementation reviews.
* **Leave the Place Better Than You Found It:** Assume every process executed today will be repeated tomorrow. Document workflows, automate manual steps, and establish telemetry to scale future execution. Qualifications

**What You ll Bring**

* **8+ Years of Relevant Experience:** Proven track record of delivering cross-functional technical or operational projects as an Implementation Manager, Technical Program Manager (TPM), Technical Consultant, Product manager or Fintech Delivery Lead.
* **Systems Literacy Practical Technical Curiosity:** Ability to interpret system architecture diagrams, ask sharp and challenging questions about technical designs, run Postman calls for testing/validation, and build basic tables/dashboards in Looker or SQL.
* **Program Management Excellence:** Strong foundation in project/program delivery best practices-from scoping and brief writing to designing governance structures, stakeholder reporting, and post-implementation audits.
* **Exceptional Communication Skills:** Outstanding written and verbal communication. Ability to adjust messaging seamlessly whether facilitating alignment with product managers, clarifying requirements with engineers, or updating business leaders.
* **Pattern Recognition Structured Thinking:** Ability to absorb unstructured information across disparate domains, spot commonalities, and design standardized, repeatable frameworks.

**What You ll benefit from**

* **Payments / FinCrime / Platform Exposure:** Exposure to Fintech, Payments, Financial Crime (AML, Fraud, KYC), or platform integration projects.

00762fcc.title: Solutions Engineer
00762fcc.description:
**Meet the Team**
You will be in Global Enterprise Segment (GES) where we lead Cisco's top 500 strategic accounts. Our responsibility to Cisco’s business is phenomenal, and our responsibility to each other and our culture is greater. We have a dedicated focus on our customers' success, we are Cisco's growth engine and shape the company’s future. Our values customer focused Always, Show Up to Win Every Day, and Harness the Power of Cisco is how we get the job done, and our Win As One mentality embodies the spirit of the journey and how we will show up with each other, partners, and customers.
  
  
**Your Impact**
We are looking for a Solutions Engineer (SE) with Enterprise Networking, Data Center, Collaboration, Security, Automation, and Cloud background. The SE role is a customer focused technical sales professional who ensures that technical information and guidance is provided to the customer, delivering meaningful outcomes based on Cisco’s product and services portfolio. You will partner with your Account Managers in a pre-sales technical function, showcasing Cisco solutions, providing customer presentations, performing technical demonstrations, creating BoM’s, and running proof of concept activities. SE’s partner, consult, influence and design solutions to allow the customer to meet their desired outcomes. In addition to technology proficiency and the ability to learn quickly and stay ahead of; the ideal candidate's interpersonal, presentation and troubleshooting skills should evoke passion and confidence.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Technology solution consultant to the customer and the Cisco account team.
* Leverage an array of Cisco technology, services, and support specialists.
* Collaborate closely with Account Manager on account planning activities.
* Educate the customer on Cisco differentiation, creating demand.
* Set brand preference to Cisco.
* Align Cisco’s product and services capabilities to customers business drivers.
* You are determined and have a long history in the Networking field.
* You will also have a strong background in large enterprises and/or large service provider IT accounts and understand how to engage new lines of business to drive understanding and preference to Cisco's Routing & Switching, Data Center, Security, and Internet of Things solutions.
* Strong business acumen and customer presence.
* Experience and comfort conversing with network and telecommunications managers as well as customer lines of business on Data Center, Security, and Retail solutions.
* As a Solutions Engineer, you'll be responsible for driving customer activities and discussions that lead to preference of Cisco's Routing & Switching, Data Center, Security, and Automation solutions.
* The focus of this position is to uncover business benefits for a customer by consulting on Cisco solutions and applications to solve business problems, working with multi-functional teams to design and present appropriate technical solution, and building joint plan of record for multiple engineering systems using Cisco products.
* You'll plan sales strategy, develop proposals, deliver customer presentations and demonstrations to close business and generate revenue.
* While customer facing engagements will be the primary role, other duties will include training colleagues on Data Center, Virtualization and MOCA topics and practices. Developing best practices in sales approaches and technical execution.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in pre-sales engineering or the broader computing/IT industry, with a strong focus on Cisco Enterprise Routing & Switching, Data Center, and Security solutions.
* In-depth knowledge of large IT environments and applications.
* Deep understanding and operational experience with a routed and switched data/voice network.
* Cisco product experience or relevant experience in key competitor offerings in technology area of emphasis required.
* Minimum CCNP or similar vendor certification required.
* Knowledge of Cisco's Solutions, networking fundamentals required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Pre-Sales experience preferred.
* Typically requires BS/BA (EE/CS) or equivalent.
* Customer intimacy skills

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

2344b3db.description:
**Overview**
our purpose is to empower organizations to transform the way they work by harnessing the full potential of artificial intelligence. We guide customers through the evolving digital landscape, enabling them to unlock new opportunities, enhance productivity, and deliver exceptional employee and customer experiences. By integrating advanced AI capabilities across devices, cloud platforms, and everyday business applications, we help organizations realize seamless, innovative, and secure solutions that drive sustained growth and success in the AI era.
  
  
As a Solution Engineer in the AI Business Solutions – Copilot team, you will lead technical engagements that drive AI transformation for enterprise customers. Your mission is to win technical decisions and accelerate adoption of Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Copilot Studio & Agents, and related solutions by delivering compelling demos, envisioning sessions, and scalable architectures. You will act as a trusted advisor, guiding customers through secure, compliant, and value-driven implementations that align with their enterprise strategies.
  
  
This role is pivotal in shaping the future of work by enabling customers to realize the full potential of AI-powered productivity. You will collaborate closely with sales, customer success, engineering, and partner teams to remove technical blockers, generate pipeline, and ensure seamless handoffs for deployment and adoption. * Assist in ME3 , ME5 , ME7 , Agent 365 upsell opportunities focused on Teams Phone that require technical support, and bring in a partner for co-sell.

* Maintain operational excellence with 100% deal hygiene – capture technical close plans and consumption plans in MSX for every opportunity, attach a partner to every qualified deal, and promptly escalate unresolved technical blockers.
* Continuously upskill to meet role expectations (achieve L200 consultative and L400 technical depth certifications) and contribute to team excellence by sharing at least one deal win/loss insight per quarter and engaging in regular coaching.

**Qualifications**
Core Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8-10 years of Experience in pre-sales, solution engineering, technical consulting, or customer-facing technical roles.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft Copilot technologies, Generative AI, and AI-powered productivity solutions.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Power Platform, and Azure AI services.
* Understanding of Microsoft 365 workloads such as:

+ Microsoft Teams
+ SharePoint
+ Outlook
+ Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

* Basic to advanced knowledge of cloud architecture, identity, security, and compliance concepts.
* Ability to build demos, proof-of-concepts, and customer solution architectures.

* Experience conducting customer discovery sessions and identifying business challenges.
* Ability to translate business requirements into AI-powered solutions.
* Strong presentation, storytelling, and executive communication skills.
* Experience leading technical demonstrations and workshops.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with AI, machine learning, prompt engineering, or conversational agents.
* Knowledge of enterprise productivity, business process automation, and digital transformation.
* Relevant Microsoft certifications (for example, Azure AI, Power Platform, or Microsoft 365 certifications

Join a team of passionate thought leaders in a dynamic and collaborative environment! Cognizant Microsoft Business Group’s
**Business Applications**
team is hiring now and we’re looking for our next
**D**
**ynamics 365 CE and Power Apps Pre-Sales Consultant**
to join us. The role has an immediate start and would be on a permanent contract.
  
  
The Microsoft Business Group is a cloud-first, full-service Microsoft partner committed to delivering innovative technology solutions that solve human challenges. We are compelled by our core values to drive transformational results for clients across all company sizes, geographies and industries. The Cognizant Microsoft Business Group team delivers full lifecycle solutions—from project inception and planning, through deployment to ongoing support and maintenance.
  
  
**Why should you work at Microsoft Business Group?**
Multi Award Winning Business
  
  
Official and Award-Winning Microsoft Partner
  
  
Award Winning Databricks Partner
  
  
Official GitHub Partner
  
  
Cloud Native Organisation
  
  
Growing International and Diverse teams
  
  
Hugely collaborative environment, where ideas and knowledge sharing are actively encouraged
  
  
Private Medical Insurance
  
  
Employee Assistance Programme
  
  
Income Protection Cover
  
  
Death in Service Cover
  
  
Group Personal Pension Plan with enhanced employee contributions
  
  
Flexible Working and Working from Home
  
  
Enhanced annual leave allowance
  
  
We are committed to diversity, inclusion and belonging and welcome applicants from all backgrounds
  
  
**What impact will you have in this role?**
The ideal candidate will be an ambitious and enthusiastic consultant who will nurture needs and deliver Microsoft Business Applications solutions for existing and prospective clients. Working with the Business Analysis, sales professionals’ practice and client teams to design, build, oversee, and implement solutions using the Power Platform and Dynamics 365 customer engagement first-party applications. You should be experience in articulating architectural designs in written form, with the ability to explain complex concepts in clear. concise form that can be understood by Business stakeholders.
  
  
**What will the Dynamics 365 CE and Power Apps Pre-Sales Consultant be doing day to day in their role?**
Supporting Microsoft Business Group sellers, Cognizant sellers, client partners and customer relationship managers and Microsoft co-selling to win Dynamics 365 F&O work with existing and new customers, both proactive outgoing initiatives and responding to incoming requests, RFPs, ITTs and Frameworks.
  
  
As the Dynamics CE , leading initial discovery with customers to establish their needs, outcomes and how these can best be supported through Dynamics CE, wider Power Platform and embracing Agentic AI
  
  
Identifying and creating with MBG Offering Team Industry and cross industry go to market solutions, supporting as the subject matter expert marketing and other promotional campaigns.
  
  
Advising customers on the fit of Microsoft Dynamics CE and the wider Power Platform to their environment, infrastructure, functional and non-functional needs, and their compliance requirements
  
  
Work on and support the completion of response to customer demand. These could be a simple and straight forward PoC that requires architectural review, or a complex enterprise architecture
  
  
Have excellent interpersonal skill and be able to work in a wide, diverse group of stakeholders.
  
  
Have experience of taking a concept at enterprise level, create the scope (temporal, financial, resource) and translate this into an executable design that competitive positions us well in the market, using the appropriate levers to deliver a compelling bid.
  
  
**What type of experience does the Dynamics 365 CE and Power Apps Pre-Sales Consultant need to be successful in this role?**
Must have over 10+ years of experience in Microsoft stack with strong experience working as a Technical Consultant or Solution Architect in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE (CRM)
  
  
Strong understanding of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE and experience of working on full life-cycle implementations across Dynamics 365 CE Sales, Service, Customer Insights , Power Apps, Power Apps and preferably Field Services too.
  
  
Deep understanding of Co Pilot Agentic AI solutions and their fit within and around Dynamics CE
  
  
Understand customer environment and advise on fit of Dynamics CE to their needs including integration with third party systems.
  
  
Understanding of high-level solution architecture and fit of Dynamics CE solutions within customers target environment
  
  
Ability to lead response to clients such as RFP’s, RFIs, POC, Discovery and Demonstrations.
  
  
Ability to take an aspiration design and turn it into an executable design
  
  
Experienced in data integration and data migration
  
  
Experience with onsite/offshore delivery models
  
  
Experience with defined frameworks (MVC, Entity Framework and Enterprise Library)
  
  
Strong client facing communication skills
  
  
Experienced providing Pre-Sales demonstrations.
  
  
Good experience and knowledge of
  
  
Microsoft Azure
  
  
**What education and certification credentials are needed for this role?**
Educated to degree level or equivalent
  
  
TOGAF certified ideally
  
  
Certified in an Agile methodology
  
  
Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE/CRM certification (preferably Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Sales– MB-210 to 240) is highly desirable

We encourage our team members to meet with our customers in person for at least 20% of the time they are working together. Sometimes this requires travel outside of normal working hours.

491acafd.title: Data Architect Sr. Advisor
491acafd.description:
**India T Special Bonus:**  
**Req ID:** 376321
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Data Architect Sr. Advisor to join our team in Hyderabad, Telangana (IN-TG), India (IN).
  
  
Experience
  

* Overall Experience: 10+ years in Data Management, Data Integration, and Enterprise Data Architecture
* Reltio Experience: 4+ years of hands-on implementation experience in Reltio MDM
* Location: Flexible / Hybrid (based on business needs)

Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Reltio MDM Architect to join our Data Practice – Master Data Management (MDM) Center of Excellence (COE). The individual will play a strategic and technical leadership role in building our Reltio practice while supporting pre-sales, solution architecture, delivery excellence, innovation, and competency development.
  
  
This role requires a combination of strong customer-facing consulting skills, deep Reltio product expertise, enterprise data architecture knowledge, and the ability to build reusable assets and best practices that accelerate client engagements.

Pre-Sales Solutioning
  

* Engage with customers to understand business and technical requirements.
* Design end-to-end Reltio MDM solutions aligned with enterprise architecture.
* Prepare solution approaches, architecture diagrams, implementation roadmaps, and effort estimations.
* Participate in RFP/RFI responses, proposal creation, and technical presentations.
* Conduct customer workshops and discovery sessions.
* Support business development teams in identifying opportunities and defining winning solutions.

Proof of Concepts (POCs) Innovation
  

* Lead the design and implementation of Reltio proof-of-concepts.
* Demonstrate business value through rapid prototyping and solution validation.
* Evaluate new Reltio capabilities and complementary technologies.
* Recommend best-fit architecture for customer use cases.

Delivery Support
  

* Provide architecture governance across implementation projects.
* Guide project teams on Reltio best practices and implementation standards.
* Support complex technical issues, design reviews, and performance optimization.
* Ensure scalable, secure, and high-quality solution delivery.
* Mentor delivery teams during implementation and production support phases.

Competency COE Development
  

* Establish and strengthen the Reltio MDM competency within the Data Practice.
* Define architecture standards, implementation guidelines, and reusable design patterns.
* Mentor architects, consultants, and developers.
* Conduct internal technical training sessions and knowledge-sharing workshops.
* Create learning paths and certification plans for Reltio consultants.

Accelerators Framework Development

* Develop reference architectures, implementation playbooks, and best practices.
* Create reusable data quality, data governance, matching, survivorship, and integration assets.
* Continuously improve delivery methodologies and automation capabilities.

* Strong understanding of:
* Customer 360
* Product MDM
* Supplier MDM
* Reference Data Management
* Hierarchy Management
* Match Merge
* Survivorship Rules
* Identity Resolution
* Data Stewardship
* Data Quality concepts

* Match and Merge configuration
* Survivorship configuration
* Reltio Integration Hub (RIH)
* Reltio APIs (REST)
* Event Streaming
* Workflow configuration
* Data Import/Export
* Security and Role Management
* Reltio Console administration

Data Integration
  
  
Experience integrating Reltio with enterprise ecosystems using:
  

* Informatica
* Boomi
* MuleSoft
* Talend
* Azure Data Factory
* Apache Kafka
* REST APIs
* ETL/ELT platforms

Data Cloud Technologies
  

* SQL
* JSON/XML
* Data Modeling
* Data Warehousing
* Data Governance
* Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Snowflake, Databricks, or similar cloud data platforms

Preferred Skills
  

* Experience with data governance and data quality platforms.
* Knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks.
* Experience in data migration and modernization programs.
* Understanding of AI/ML-enabled data management capabilities.
* Experience working in global consulting or IT services organizations.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies.

Leadership Expectations
  

* Serve as the technical leader for Reltio engagements.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, sales teams, delivery teams, and customer architects.
* Influence technology direction and implementation strategy.
* Drive innovation and continuous improvement within the MDM COE.
* Contribute to practice growth through thought leadership and reusable intellectual property.

Qualifications
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* Reltio certifications are highly preferred.
* Relevant certifications in cloud platforms or data management technologies are an added advantage.

Desired Competencies
  

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong consulting and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to lead architecture discussions with senior customer stakeholders.
* Strong presentation and documentation skills.
* Experience working with distributed global teams.
* Self-driven with a passion for innovation and knowledge sharing.

Success Measures
  

* Successful contribution to pre-sales pursuits and proposal wins.
* Delivery of scalable, high-quality Reltio implementations.
* Development of reusable accelerators and solution assets.
* Growth of the organization's Reltio competency through mentoring and training.
* Improved delivery efficiency through COE standards and best practices.
* High customer satisfaction and successful project outcomes.

07bf527c.title: Senior Solutions Architect
07bf527c.description:
We are looking for passionate technologists to join our Pre-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.
  
  
MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. Our team is made up of seasoned technical sales professionals, software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. You'll work closely with our sales executives, helping customers solve business problems by leveraging our solutions, playing a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Mumbai for our hybrid working model.
  
  
As an ideal candidate, you will have:
  
  

* Ideally 8 to 11 years of related experience in a customer facing role, with 5 to 7 years of experience in pre-sales with enterprise software
* Minimum of 3 years experience with modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, SQL) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Java, C#) in a professional capacity
* Experience designing with scalable and highly available distributed systems in the cloud and on-prem
* Demonstrated ability to work with customers to review complex architecture of existing applications, providing guidance on how to improve by leveraging technology
* Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and business concepts in a clear and compelling manner to technology and business leadership
* Ability to strategize with sales teams and provide recommendations on how to drive a multi-threaded account strategy, aligning other MongoDB and ecosystem resources to move towards a mutually beneficial account plan
* The ability to travel up to 25%
* A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

You may also have:
  
  

* Experience selling databases and/or deploying applications with any of the major cloud providers
* Experience with database programming and data models
* Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects
* Experience in transforming legacy systems and platforms into modern, scalable, and efficient technology stacks
* Understanding of popular sales methodologies/ frameworks such as MEDDPICC/ Command of the Message
* A MongoDB Certification
* A Cloud Provider Certification

What you do at MongoDB:
  
  
In this role, you will work on complex opportunities where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors. You will:
  
  

* Design and Architect: Design scalable and performant applications, systems and infrastructure for large software projects leveraging MongoDB
* Customer Advising and Value Articulation: Guide customers on architecture patterns and optimisation strategies for MongoDB, while clearly communicating its business value to the relevant stakeholders
* Sales Partnership: Collaborate with the sales team to drive account success through account planning, opportunity prioritization/qualification and pipeline generation strategy, while taking ownership of the technical aspects (including but not limited to technical discovery, demos, proof of value, presentations, sizing and documentation)
* Demand Generation: Proactively generate demand within the sales territory through self-driven technical initiatives, participation in events such as industry trade shows and account-based marketing events
* Customer Success: Foster strong customer relationships, build champions and ensure customer success and satisfaction
* Innovation and Improvement: Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve MongoDB solutions and processes (e.g. by relaying field feedback to the product team), as well as proactively mentor other Solutions Consulting team members
* Personal Training and Development: Engage in ongoing training and professional development to stay abreast of MongoDB product suite as well as industry trends

What you will learn:
  
  
MongoDB Product Suite Mastery:
  
  

* Core Database Server: Master the fundamentals and advanced features of MongoDB's core database
* Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts
* Relational Migrator: Learn to migrate from relational databases seamlessly

Market-Relevant Technologies:
  
  

* Hyperscaler Ecosystem: Gain expertise in designing complex systems utilizing cloud services on hyperscaler platforms
* Complementary Technologies: Enhance your skills with partner and complementary technologies such as Apache Kafka and Kubernetes

Modern Architecture Design:
  
  

* Design Patterns and Methodologies: Embrace best practices in microservices, DevOps, cloud, and security
* Cutting Edge RAG and AI Architectures: Help customers on their generative AI journeys and working with industry leading partners in the space

Sales Techniques and Soft Skills:
  
  

* Effective Communication: Master presentations, demonstrations, and whiteboarding
* Client Interaction: Develop strategies for discovery and objection handling

Industry Insights:
  
  

* Diverse Market Verticals: Gain exposure to a broad spectrum of interesting use cases across various industries

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

3a2b3bc4.title: Principal Solutions Engineer
3a2b3bc4.description:
**Position Overview**
Solution Engineers (SEs) at SingleStore are solving some of the most cutting-edge technical challenges in today’s data-driven world. When customers evaluate SingleStore, SEs are their trusted technical experts who evaluate, identify, and demonstrate how SingleStore can solve their mission-critical business needs. As key contributors to our sales organization, Solution Engineers add tremendous value to the customer journey and directly impact company growth and revenue.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for identifying the technical requirements necessary to deliver business value for our Fortune 1,000 customers. Working in partnership with Enterprise Account Executives, you will help to acquire new customers and expand existing accounts. You will do this by leveraging your technical skill set and business acumen to understand complex solutions and create high-quality demos that resonate with our customers.
  
  
**Role And Responsibilities**

* Partner with Prospects and Customers to understand their industries and strategies, and educate them on SingleStores strategy, technologies and vision.
* Partner with Account Executives to close new business (logos) and expand existing accounts
* Partner with internal teams (Product, Engineering, Support, Marketing etc.) to share feedback on customer needs and requests
* Design, develop, and deploy Proofs of Concept (POCs) with prospective customers
* Drive the technical evaluation stage of the sales cycle, acting as the technical lead/subject matter expert (query tuning, load testing, etc.)
* Work to develop Channels and Partners for co-selling in the region.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Fluency in English and regional languages
* Experience with Gen AI, ML and Advanced Analytics
* Experience successfully selling enterprise database technologies, distributed systems, and similar products
* Deep understanding of distributed database technologies, including both analytic and transactional processing
* Expertise executing POCs, with experience designing and deploying complex technologies into existing customer environments
* In-Depth understanding of data platforms, including various competitive products (Oracle, SQL Server, Postgres, MongoDB, Snowflake, Databricks, etc.)
* Experienced in cloud and containerized environments, deployment and orchestration (including Linux and Kubernetes environments)
* Proficient programming skills in Python, Java, or other programming languages
* Ability to travel within the region and internationally
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a relevant technical field

SingleStore is a global database company that empowers the world’s leading organizations to build and scale cutting-edge AI applications on a unified data platform that supports real-time transactions, analytics, and search. Our platform handles streaming data ingestion, vector search, full-text search, and multi-model data types - all with high performance, petabyte-scale capacity, high user concurrency, and low latency.
  
  
As a leader recognized by both Gartner and Forrester Wave, SingleStore serves the world ‘s leading data innovators including the top Fortune 500 enterprises. Our 95%+ gross retention rate reflects the strong satisfaction and trusts our customers place in the platform. SingleStore is owned by private equity firm Vector Capital and is headquartered in San Francisco, with offices worldwide, including Hyderabad.
  
  
*To all recruitment agencies: SingleStore does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to SingleStore employees. SingleStore is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.*

82154f68.title: Salesforce Field Service Architect
82154f68.description:
**Description**
Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
  
  
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include--but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development & delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**Requirements**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End-to-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
We are seeking an exceptional and highly experienced
**Consulting Architect**
to join our Global Capability Center. This senior role is critical to the success of our global customers, focusing on the strategic design and hands-on implementation of the Elastic Stack with focus on Search AI.
  
  
You will serve as a trusted technical architect and consultant, working with complex enterprise environments to translate business challenges into robust, scalable, and value-driven Elastic solutions. The role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, senior-level consulting acumen, and the ability to work effectively across time zones, with both remote support and required on-site client engagement.

As a member of our professional services team you will deliver Elastic solutions and Elastic stack expertise to drive customer business value from our products. Your activities will include end-to-end delivery of ground-breaking Elastic projects to our customers, as well as development of proof-of-concepts that highlight the value of the Elastic Stack and its solutions. Other topics will include Elastic solutions adaption and acceleration along with data modeling, query development and optimization, cluster tuning and scaling with a focus on fast search and analytics at scale.
  
  
Daily tasks include driving and handling the objectives, requirements gathering, project tasks, project status, dependencies, and timelines, to ensure engagements are delivered optimally and on time while meeting and exceeding the customer objectives. Your goal is to make your customers love Elastic and achieve amazing value from the platform!

Engage with the Elastic Sales team to scope opportunities while assessing technical risks, questions, or concerns. Be a mentor to your team members, while also learning from them to accelerate your skills
  
  
**What You Bring:**
**Essential Qualifications**

* Elastic Certification: Required – Active Elastic Certified Engineer certification is mandatory.
* Experience: Minimum of 7+ years as a Consulting Architect, Senior Technical Consultant, or equivalent senior IT functional role.
* Consulting History: A strong history of working as a Consultant delivering professional services engagements in complex enterprise environments.

* Experience in leading and delivering Enterprise Search projects at both the architectural and program level.
* Experience in GenAI, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector embeddings.
* Deep understanding of distributed architecture including application, database and systems.
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with on-prem systems and/or major public/private cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Technical Depth: Hands-on experience in Linux, networking, security, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation.
* Programming/Scripting: Experience utilizing programming or scripting languages in a corporate environment (e.g., Python, Javascript, Go).
* Communication: Exceptional customer advocacy, relationship-building, and soft skills including whiteboarding and driving architectural conversations. Proven ability to lead and articulate technical solutions to stakeholders.
* Travel: Ability and willingness to travel to client sites periodically as required for project success (up to 20%)
* Work Style: Comfortable working effectively in a highly distributed and remote team, spanning multiple global time zones.

**Bonus Points:**

* Any cloud service provider's - Gen AI certification.
* Additional Elastic Certifications (e.g., Elastic Certified Analyst, Specializations) and/or specialization in machine learning, data analytics.
* Experience working closely with a pre-sales organization in scoping customer needs and delivering against a Statement of Work (SOW).
* Experience as a technical instructor or public speaker on enterprise infrastructure software.
* Experience contributing to an open-source project or documentation.

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:**
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

dcf1c942.title: Application Security Architect
dcf1c942.description:
**Job Title:** Application Security Architect  
 **Experience: 12+ Years**  
 **Location: Hyderabad (Hybrid)**

  

**Position Summary:**

We are looking for a hands-on \*\*Application Security Architect\*\* who combines strong software engineering skills with deep application security expertise. This is a generalist role you should be comfortable reading and writing production-quality code across multiple languages, and equally comfortable designing and running an AppSec program that spans SAST, DAST, and SCA tooling, secure architecture reviews, and developer enablementThis position will require occasional after-hours and weekend work. The selected candidate will be expected to attend work on a regular and predictable schedule in accordance with agency leave policy and perform other duties as assigned.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

- Design and drive the application security strategy across the SDLC from design reviews through CI/CD to production.

- Own and continuously tune \*\*SAST\*\* (e.g., Checkmarx, Fortify, Semgrep, CodeQL), \*\*DAST\*\* (e.g., Burp Suite Enterprise, OWASP ZAP, Invicti), and \*\*SCA\*\* (e.g., Snyk, Black Duck, Mend, Dependency-Track) tooling — integration, rule tuning, false-positive reduction, and coverage.

- Perform secure architecture and design reviews for new features, services, and major system changes.

- Read, write, and refactor code (not just review it) to build internal tooling, PoCs for vulnerabilities, custom scanners, and secure-by-default libraries/frameworks.

- Conduct manual code reviews and threat modeling for high-risk services, complementing automated tooling.

- Partner with engineering teams to remediate vulnerabilities, and act as a technical escalation point for security findings.

- Build and maintain CI/CD security gates (pre-commit hooks, pipeline scanning, break-the-build policies).

- Define and evangelize secure coding standards, guardrails, and reusable security patterns/libraries.

- Run or support penetration tests and coordinate remediation with engineering.

- Mentor developers and security champions; deliver secure coding training.

- Track and report AppSec metrics (vulnerability density, MTTR, tool coverage, false-positive rates) to leadership.

- Stay current on emerging threats (OWASP Top 10, CWE/SANS Top 25, supply chain attacks) and evolve the program accordingly.

**Required Skills**

\*\***Engineering foundation** (must-have — this is a generalist coding role, not a pure GRC/tooling role): \*\*

- Strong hands-on software development experience in at least one backend language (e.g., Java, Python, Go, Node.js, C#) and working familiarity with others.

- Comfortable reading and writing code across the stack — APIs, web front ends, mobile, or infrastructure-as-code, as relevant to your environment.

- Solid understanding of software design patterns, frameworks, and modern CI/CD pipelines.

\*\***Application security expertise**: \*\*

- Deep, practical experience with \*\*SAST\*\*, \*\*DAST\*\*, and \*\*SCA\*\* tools — selection, deployment, tuning, and interpreting results (not just running scans).

- Strong grasp of OWASP Top 10, OWASP ASVS, CWE/SANS Top 25, and secure design principles (authN/authZ, cryptography, input validation, session management).

- Experience with threat modeling methodologies (STRIDE, PASTA, or similar).

- Familiarity with container/cloud security (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure/GCP security services) is a plus.

- Understanding of software supply chain security (SBOM, dependency risk, artifact signing).

- Experience building custom security tooling or writing SAST/DAST rules.

- Exposure to regulated industries (BFSI, healthcare) or compliance frameworks (PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2).

6157cb97.title: Consulting Architect - Platform
6157cb97.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
You are the person a customer calls when their Elasticsearch platform is the problem, or when they need one designed properly the first time.
  
  
That means you decide the shape of a cluster and then defend that decision — node topology, shard strategy, data tiers, lifecycle and retention — with the sizing arithmetic to back it up. It also means you can follow a performance problem beyond Elastic itself. We need someone whose instinct is to look down the stack and sideways to whatever else shares the infrastructure, rather than stopping at the cluster API.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**

* Design and build Elasticsearch platforms for customers across self-managed, orchestrated and managed deployments, including air-gapped and regulated environments
* Own sizing and capacity planning as a derivation from workload characteristics — ingest rate, document shape, retention, query concurrency, growth — validated by benchmark rather than estimated from a form
* Run health checks and remediation on production estates, and redesign sharding, mapping and index strategies where the original design no longer holds
* Lead major-version upgrades, snapshot and disaster recovery strategy, and multi-cluster architectures
* Diagnose performance problems across the full stack — Elastic, the JVM, the operating system, storage and network — and across adjacent systems in the data path
* Work directly with customer architects, platform owners and engineering leadership; run discovery, present designs, and own the technical outcome of an engagement end to end
* Build reusable tooling, automation and IP that makes the next engagement faster, including AI-assisted tooling for diagnosis, configuration and reporting
* Mentor other consultants and contribute to the GCC's technical practice

**What You Bring:**
**Elastic depth — non-negotiable**
We
**are not looking**
for someone who will learn Elastic on the job.
  
  

* 8+ years hands-on with the Elastic Stack, substantially on cluster and platform work rather than dashboarding or pipeline authoring
* Shard strategy you can derive, not recite — how you arrived at a shard count and size for a given workload, what you traded off, and what you got wrong the first time
* Index and mapping design, and why those choices drive cluster performance
* Lifecycle and retention across data tiers, including the cost and latency implications of each
* Snapshot, restore and disaster recovery designed and executed, not just configured
* Major-version upgrades in production — the sequencing, the breaking changes, the rollback position
* More than one deployment model: self-managed plus at least one managed or orchestrated option
* Cluster stability and performance troubleshooting — heap and garbage collection, circuit breakers, thread pool rejections, shard allocation, expensive queries
* Elastic Certified Engineer, or the demonstrable knowledge to obtain it within your first quarter
* Strong Linux and operating system fundamentals, with solid grounding in storage and networking
* A working understanding of how infrastructure conditions translate into Elastic symptoms, and how infrastructure choices constrain what a deployment can do
* Experience troubleshooting on shared infrastructure, where the cause of your problem is another workload's behaviour and resolving it means engaging the team that owns it

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:**
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
  
  
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
  
  

* Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
* Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles

Good experience and knowledge of

Microsoft Azure

Educated to degree level or equivalent

TOGAF certified ideally

Certified in an Agile methodology

Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE/CRM certification (preferably Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Sales– MB-210 to 240) is highly desirable

We encourage our team members to meet with our customers in person for at least 20% of the time they are working together. Sometimes this requires travel outside of normal working hours.

All employees must act in accordance with Cognizant corporate security standards.

VEMIO discovers and maps a client's network (switches, firewalls, access points, cameras), monitors traffic, and raises alerts/tickets on failure.
