**Requirements**

* Graduate; engineering/technology background preferred
* **4-8 years in B2B sales, incl. at least 3 years selling software/SaaS/managed services to enterprises**
* Proven track record closing and renewing annual/multi-year contracts
* Able to explain technical products to both IT teams and business decision-makers
* Can run the full sales cycle independently, prospecting to contract
* Clear written/spoken English and Hindi
* **Willing to travel across India**

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

ea0b5b31.description:
### **Technology**

DGS India - Pune - Indiqube Orchid

#### **About the job**

**Job Title: AEM Technical Architect**

We are seeking a forward-thinking and technically strong **Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Technical Architect** to lead the design, modernization, and integration of scalable digital experience platforms. This role acts as the **technology lead and CMS subject matter expert** for client engagements, with deep knowledge of AEM as a Cloud Service, composable and headless architectures, modern authoring models, and high-performance delivery patterns such as Edge Delivery Services with Universal Editor. You will architect enterprise-grade AEM solutions, guide modernization from legacy implementations, apply AI-enabled development and operations practices, and proactively identify better ways to deliver measurable value for clients.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Architecture & Design**

* Architect robust, secure, and scalable AEM solutions across Sites, Assets, Content Fragments, Experience Fragments, Headless CMS, GraphQL/OpenAPI integrations, and Edge Delivery Services-enabled experiences.
* Act as the **CMS technology SME**, helping clients navigate platform capabilities and recommending the most effective solutions.
* Evaluate and design integrations with surrounding systems including CRM, DAM, marketing automation, and analytics.
* Assess when to use traditional AEM Sites, headless/composable delivery, document-based authoring, or Edge Delivery Services depending on client needs, migration complexity, performance goals, and operating model.
* Define modernization roadmaps for AEM 6.5, AMS, and AEM as a Cloud Service estates, including phased adoption of Universal Editor, Edge Delivery Services, content modeling, and API-first delivery.

**Technology Leadership**

* Lead cross-functional technical teams, ensuring best practices in architecture, development, and deployment.
* Guide technology choices for **frontend**, **backend**, and delivery architecture—balancing modern frameworks, Universal Editor compatibility, performance, maintainability, scalability, and enterprise governance.
* Participate hands-on when necessary, especially in complex integrations or issue resolutions.
* Lead PoCs and define reusable frameworks, accelerators, block libraries, starter kits, and reference architectures for AEM Cloud Service and Edge Delivery Services implementations.
* Use AI-assisted and agentic development practices responsibly to accelerate code quality checks, migration analysis, content modeling, troubleshooting, and delivery workflows while maintaining human review and architectural ownership.

**Client Engagement & Innovation**

* Act as the **primary technical point of contact** for clients on CMS solutions, providing trusted guidance and making proactive recommendations—not just reacting to requests.
* Drive innovation by staying informed on AEM as a Cloud Service releases, Edge Delivery Services, Universal Editor, Adobe Experience Cloud integrations, content supply chain evolution, and broader CMS/DXP trends.
* Advise clients on pragmatic adoption of emerging capabilities, including where greenfield Edge Delivery Services implementations, selective brownfield modernization, and traditional AEM Sites approaches are most appropriate.

**Integration & Performance**

* Design and implement integrations using REST, GraphQL, SOAP where required, event-driven patterns, Adobe I/O, middleware, cloud-native services, and composable enterprise APIs.
* Ensure solutions are optimized for performance and scale, applying Dispatcher and CDN strategies where relevant, and leveraging Edge Delivery Services for low-latency, high-performing web experiences when appropriate.
* Establish data flow architectures that ensure data consistency, security, and integrity.

**Governance, Security & Compliance**

* Enforce coding and architecture standards, security best practices, privacy-by-design principles, accessibility, content governance, release governance, and Cloud Manager quality gates in line with organizational and client-specific guidelines.

**Team Enablement & Collaboration**

* Collaborate closely with developers, business analysts, and client stakeholders.
* Provide mentorship to team members across disciplines (backend, frontend, DevOps) to build collective strength.
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement and shared accountability.
  

  

* **Required Skills & Experience**10+ years of experience in enterprise software engineering or solution architecture, with significant hands-on experience in Adobe Experience Manager and modern digital experience platforms.Deep knowledge of AEM architecture, including Sites, Assets, Content Fragments, Experience Fragments, Headless CMS, GraphQL, Universal Editor, Edge Delivery Services, and AEM as a Cloud Service operating models.Strong expertise in Java, Sling, OSGi, HTL, JCR, Dispatcher configuration, and CI/CD pipelines.Frontend expertise in modern frameworks such as React, Angular, Vue, or similar technologies, with solid understanding of web performance, accessibility, Core Web Vitals, and framework-agnostic authoring patterns.Proficient in backend integrations using REST/SOAP, middleware tools, and message brokers.Strong understanding of database technologies, cloud platforms, Adobe Cloud Manager, CI/CD automation, observability, DevOps practices, and deployment governance across AWS, Azure, or equivalent cloud environments.Experience working in Agile delivery models with a focus on rapid value delivery and iterative design.Experience with migration or modernization programs, including AEM 6.5 to AEM as a Cloud Service, component refactoring, content model redesign, performance remediation, and platform rationalization.
  

  

* **Nice to Have**
* Awareness or hands-on experience with **Content Supply Chain tools** such as Adobe Workfront, Adobe Express, DAM workflows, asset lifecycle management, review/approval automation, and content velocity optimization.Familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud products beyond AEM.Experience with Adobe I/O, App Builder, GraphQL, OpenAPI, personalization, experimentation, analytics integration, and AI-assisted content or development workflows.Exposure to agentic AEM concepts, AI-supported pipeline troubleshooting, developer agents, content modernization agents, or automated migration accelerators.Working knowledge of other CMS platforms (e.g., Contentful, Sitecore, Drupal) to provide comparative insight.
  

  

* **Soft Skills****Proactive mindset** – ability to anticipate client needs and offer improvements, not just fulfill requests.Strategic thinker with excellent problem-solving abilities.Strong communication and storytelling skills – capable of translating complex technical concepts into business-friendly language.Team player with leadership presence and the ability to influence across teams and stakeholders.
  

  

* ### **Education**

  Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science**, Information Technology**, or a related technical discipline.undefined

29b7705f.title: Program Manager
29b7705f.description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Program Manager
  
  
**Program Manager**
**About Your Role**
As a Program Manager, you will lead complex, cross-functional technical programs that span engineering, product, infrastructure, and business teams. You will partner with Principal Engineers, architects, and senior stakeholders to drive execution across large-scale initiatives while translating technical complexity into clear delivery plans and business outcomes. Your work will help improve execution discipline, reduce delivery risk, and align architecture, engineering, and operational priorities across the enterprise.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead large-scale technical programs across multiple engineering, product, and business organizations, ensuring alignment to strategic objectives, scope, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
* Partner with Principal Engineers and technical leaders to participate in architecture and system design discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and challenge assumptions that affect delivery, scale, and resilience.
* Map and manage complex dependencies, critical paths, and execution risks across software engineering, infrastructure, cloud, data platform, and application programming interface (API) workstreams.
* Define and drive program governance, including milestone tracking, risk management, issue resolution, change control, and executive reporting across cross-functional teams.
* Establish and monitor program-level key performance indicators (KPIs), service-level agreement (SLA) metrics, delivery dashboards, and operational measures that improve execution transparency and accountability.
* Apply Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid delivery frameworks to optimize planning, sprint health, throughput, and delivery predictability across technical teams.
* Identify technical risks early in the lifecycle, including structural bottlenecks, single points of failure, scalability concerns, or security risks, and drive mitigation planning with stakeholders.
* Translate technical blockers, architecture decisions, and delivery impacts into clear business context for senior leaders and non-technical stakeholders.
* Drive alignment across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders without direct authority, building consensus around technical strategy and execution priorities.
* Structure ambiguous or evolving business goals into executable technical roadmaps, sequencing plans, and cross-team workstreams.
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

**Experience You'll Need To Have**

* 8+ years of experience in software engineering, systems engineering, technical architecture, or related technical disciplines supporting complex technology environments.
* 3+ years of experience leading cross-functional technical programs involving multiple engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
* Experience engaging in technical architecture discussions across software engineering, cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, infrastructure, data platforms, and APIs.
* Experience with software development lifecycle (SDLC) processes, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), release management, and testing frameworks in enterprise delivery environments.
* Experience identifying and managing technical risks, dependencies, scaling considerations, and execution blockers across large programs.
* Experience building delivery dashboards, KPIs, milestone tracking, SLA reporting, or similar operational governance measures for technical programs.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
* Experience in financial services, payments, or other regulated technology environments.
* Experience managing external technical partners, vendors, or third-party delivery dependencies.
* Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Project Management Professional (PMP), or equivalent certification.

**How You'll Work**

* This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.

**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**

* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
  
  
**Note To Agencies**
Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
  
  
**Warning About Fake Job Posts**
Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

64084827.title: Product Program Manager
64084827.description:
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.
  
  
If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!
  
  
We’re looking for a
**Program Manager**
to be part of making this happen.
  
  
**Position Overview And Objective**
The Program Manager will manage and lead programs to drive the engineering development and implementation process for a subsystem and component of a product or service offering. Involvement lasts throughout all stages of a product’s lifecycle including ideation/concept, modifications, upgrades and maintenance of the product or product line.
  
  
The Program Manager will manage and lead strategic programs and initiatives within our cybersecurity software and services organization. This role is responsible for planning, executing, and delivering complex programs that align with business objectives, customer needs, and regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate will drive cross-functional collaboration, ensure program alignment with company strategy, and manage risks and dependencies to deliver high-quality security solutions on time and within budget.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Strategic Influence & Thought Leadership – Guides executive decision-making on product strategy, technology investments, and long-term roadmap planning.
* Enterprise-Wide Program Management – Oversees multiple complex initiatives spanning business units, ensuring strategic objectives are met across products and teams.
* Technical Due Diligence – Leads deep dives into system architecture, performance, and scalability to assess risk and feasibility for high-impact initiatives.
* Executive & Stakeholder Alignment – Communicates trade-offs, investment rationales, and progress updates to C-suite and board-level stakeholders.
* Mentorship & Organization Impact – Develops best practices, frameworks, and coaching initiatives to elevate program management capabilities across the company.
* Lead and manage large-scale cybersecurity programs from initiation through completion, ensuring alignment with company objectives.
* Develop and maintain program roadmaps, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring effective coordination across engineering, product management, marketing, legal, sales and customer success teams.
* Oversee program governance, risk management, and compliance with industry security standards and regulations.
* Define and implement best practices for program execution, tracking, and reporting, ensuring visibility and accountability.
* Serves as the primary point of contact for program stakeholders, facilitating communication and alignment across business units.
* Manage budgets, resource allocation, and vendor relationships to optimize program efficiency.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance program execution, team collaboration, and customer satisfaction.
* Serves as the central resource with design, process, manufacturing, test, quality, and marketing as the product(s) move to production and distribution.
* Designs, develops, and manages activities for a specific product or group of products from product definition and planning through production, release, and end of life.
* Coordinate activities of supporting project teams and internal and external development partners.
* Track progress against established plan and makes decisions to alter or update schedule and resource allocation to meet product requirements and development schedule.
* Mentor direct and interdisciplinary team members.
* Champion AI & Automation in Program Management – Identify and implement AI-driven tools and automation workflows to streamline program planning, status reporting, risk tracking, and cross-functional coordination, reducing manual overhead and improving program execution speed.
* Drive data-driven insights by leveraging AI-powered analytics and dashboards to proactively surface program health metrics, predict delivery risks, and support executive-level decision-making with real-time program intelligence.

**Experience & Requirements**

* 8-10 years’ experience in a technical or product role managing large-scale software deployments
* 8-10 years of experience in program / project/ product management, with at least 6 years in software development
* Bachelor’s degree required in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Business, or related field
* Understanding of project and program management skills and methodologies
* Expertise in program management methodologies (Agile, SAFe, etc.) and tools (JIRA, Confluence, Aha!, etc.).
* Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, ensuring effective communication between technical and non-technical teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify risks, dependencies, and optimization opportunities.
* Excellent leadership, negotiation, and change management skills to drive execution and adoption of cybersecurity initiatives.
* Experience communicating and representing work to leadership, framing discussions to gain valuable feedback, and experience working with technical management teams to develop systems, solutions, and products.
* Analytical and problem-solving experience with large-scale systems
* Proficient in building trust and establishing relationships across multi-disciplinary teams.
* Aptitude towards establishing and leading teams through multi-disciplinary relationships including product management and engineering to drive product programs.

**Nice to Have**

* PMP, PgMP, or SAFe certification.
* Experience in cybersecurity is a plus.
* Prefer degree in a technical area.
* Experience applying AI tools and automation platforms (e.g., Copilot, Claude, Notion AI, or similar) to enhance program management workflows such as meeting summarization, dependency tracking, and automated reporting.
* Demonstrated interest or experience in evaluating and piloting AI/ML-driven solutions within a program or product management context to improve operational efficiency and team productivity.

**On-Camera Policy**
To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.
  
  
**About Arctic Wolf**
At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2025), Best Places to Work – USA (2021-2025), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – UK (2024-2026), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024-2026). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.
  
  
**Our Values**
Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion, and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.
  
  
We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here.
  
  
We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.
  
  
All
**India**
wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:
  
  

* Equity for all employees
* Flexible annual leave, paid holidays and volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
* Fertility support and paid parental leave
* Employee Assistance Program

Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodation by emailing recruiting@arcticwolf.com. View our Hiring Page to learn more about our application process.
  
  
**Security Requirements**

* Conducts duties and responsibilities in accordance with AWN’s Information Security policies, standards, processes, and controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of AWN business information (in accordance with our employee handbook and corporate policies).
* Background checks are required for this position.
* This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”). Please note that, if applicable, an offer for employment will be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations.

256d0f79.title: Principal Solutions Architect - SAARC
256d0f79.description:
**About Us**
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
  
  
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
  
  
**Available Locations: Bengaluru/Mumbai/New Delhi**
**About The Role**
As a Principal Solutions Architect, you'll be a trusted advisor to Cloudflare's most strategic enterprise customers across the Asia Pacific region. You will work at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and executive influence, helping organisations in industries such as financial services, government, and telecommunications navigate complex digital transformation journeys using Cloudflare's platform.
  
  
You'll speak the "customer language", understand the CxO mindset, and influence technology decisions at the intersection of risk, resilience, and innovation. Whether it's advising a CISO on a Zero Trust security strategy, helping a CIO rationalise their network architecture, or working with engineering leadership on edge-native application modernisation, you'll help our most important customers reimagine how the Internet works for them and position Cloudflare as the foundational platform for that future.
  
  
You'll be embedded in account planning with our sales and solutions engineering teams, operating proactively across the full customer lifecycle; from early strategic discovery through to long-term platform adoption and expansion. As a Principal Solutions Architect, you'll also play a significant role in raising the architectural capability of the broader Solutions Engineering organisation across APAC.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own long-term executive relationships across Cloudflare's most strategic APAC accounts; engaging CIOs, CTOs, and CISOs on their multi-year technology agendas and positioning Cloudflare as a foundational platform, not a point solution.
* Design and facilitate executive vision-setting and architecture workshops that produce tangible outcomes: multi-year roadmaps, reference architectures, and business cases co-developed with customers' enterprise architects and engineering leadership.
* Translate industry trends like Zero Trust, Digital Sovereignty, AI workload security, cloud-to-edge migration into actionable architectural strategies tailored to each customer's business context and regulatory environment.
* Guide clients across the full engagement lifecycle; from strategic discovery and architecture design through proof of concept, value realisation, and expansion planning while proactively partnering with the Sales and Solutions Engineering team to surface architectural opportunities before deals are formally scoped.
* Elevate the architectural capability of the broader APAC Solutions Engineering team by developing reusable workshop frameworks, reference architectures, and best practices that others can apply independently; and by mentoring Solutions Engineers in senior stakeholder engagement.
* Represent Cloudflare externally at industry events, executive roundtables, and sector forums as a credible peer to enterprise architects and technology leaders; produce content: white papers, architectural guidance that establishes Cloudflare's voice on key transformation themes across the region.

**What Success Looks Like**
  
  

* In your first 6 months:

+ You've established trusted advisor relationships with senior technical and business stakeholders across 3-5 of Cloudflare's most strategic APAC accounts.
+ You've designed and facilitated 2-3 executive vision-setting or architecture workshops that have resulted in documented multi-year roadmap alignment with Cloudflare embedded as a core platform component.
+ You've shaped at least one strategic engagement where you've connected Cloudflare's developer and edge compute capabilities to a customer's application modernisation or AI strategy; demonstrating platform breadth beyond security alone.
+ You've contributed at least one reusable asset to the APAC SE team; a workshop framework, reference architecture, or architectural playbook that others can apply independently.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 12+ years of experience in technical presales, enterprise architecture, or IT leadership (e.g., Chief Architect, CTO, CISO).
* A genuine ability to operate at two levels simultaneously: credible in a boardroom conversation about digital strategy, and capable of going deep on architecture design with engineering teams.
* Demonstrated experience leading executive-level workshops, technology strategy sessions, or architectural visioning engagements with tangible business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of transformation priorities relevant to APAC enterprises: Zero Trust architecture, cloud and network modernisation, digital sovereignty and data residency, AI infrastructure, and application performance at scale.
* Experience with modern application architecture patterns (microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, CI/CD, serverless and edge compute).
* A track record of proactively contributing to pipeline and account expansion through architectural influence — not just responding to requests.
* Proven ability to enable and elevate peers: you've built frameworks, run internal enablement, or mentored others at scale.
* Confident, compelling communicator in both executive business settings and technical deep dives and comfortable representing Cloudflare publicly at industry events.
* Bonus: Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF), security standards (NIST SP 800-207, ISO 27001), and IT risk management principles relevant to regulated industries.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Security, or related field.
* Experience in regulated industries (FSI, Government, Telco) or complex multi-cloud/hybrid environments.
* Hands-on technical curiosity: you stay current across networking, cloud infrastructure, application security, and developer platforms; not because the job requires it, but because you find it genuinely interesting.
* Prior experience in a role that required navigating cultural and linguistic diversity across multiple APAC markets.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?
  
  
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
  
  
**Project Galileo**
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
  
  
**Athenian Project**
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
  
  
**1.1.1.1**
: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
  
  
Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!
  
  
Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.
  
  
This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.
  
  
Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.
  
  
Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

146ba6be.title: Associate Principal - Architecture
146ba6be.description:
**Role description**

Key Responsibilities

1. GenAI Solution Architecture & SDLC Acceleration

* Define the target-state architecture and adoption roadmap for AI-led SDLC: where and how AI agents participate in planning, coding, review, testing, and deployment phases.
* Extend agents upstream into engineering design: spec-driven development (specs and design documents as the source of truth agents implement against), AI-assisted architecture documentation, and agent reviewers in design and code-review gates.
* Architect end-to-end GenAI solutions — agentic developer workflows, RAG pipelines, LLM-based applications — for insurance workloads, and scale successful patterns from pilot to production.
* Lead architecture transformation accelerated by AI — core/legacy modernization and new event-driven architecture (EDA) implementations — using agents for code comprehension, documentation, migration, functional-equivalence test generation, and event schema/handler scaffolding.
* Design AI-enabled business workflows with humans in the loop: document intake and extraction, confidence thresholds and exception routing, reviewer feedback loops, and end-to-end auditability.
* Enable and coach offshore developer squads on agent-assisted engineering; define working practices, quality gates, and guardrails for AI-generated code.
* Lead a team of GenAI engineers delivering these solutions — setting technical direction, reviewing designs, and growing the team's agentic engineering capability.
* Measure and report acceleration outcomes: cycle time, throughput, quality, and adoption metrics — and iterate the blueprint based on evidence.
* Define and enforce architecture standards, design patterns, and responsible-AI practices — with particular attention to the data privacy, security, and regulatory constraints of the insurance industry; operate architecture governance — design authority, decision records, and reviews — across delivery teams.
* Establish evaluation and guardrails as first-class engineering: evaluation harnesses and golden datasets, hallucination and regression checks, output guardrails, and production monitoring for GenAI systems.

2. Agentic Engineering & Tooling (hands-on)

* Design multi-agent systems with defined roles — orchestrator, coder, reviewer, tester agents — including task routing, state management, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* Hands-on configuration and governance of GenAI developer tooling at enterprise scale: agentic coding tools — CLI-driven coding agents and AI pair-programming solutions that go well beyond autocomplete-style copilots — including tool-server (MCP) setup, custom commands, hooks, and repository context/instruction files, plus agent SDKs and orchestration frameworks.
* Design and deploy MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to expose the customer's tools, APIs, and data sources to AI agents; apply tool-use / function-calling patterns for LLM-driven agents.
* Select and integrate foundation models (e.g., Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Gemini) via APIs or managed platforms (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, Google Vertex AI); design model-tiering and routing strategies — frontier reasoning models for complex work, fast lightweight models for high-volume steps, open-weight models (Llama, Mistral) where data residency requires — balancing capability, cost, and latency.
* Deploy and operate GenAI workloads within enterprise cloud estates: private endpoints and network isolation, identity and access management, quota / rate-limit and regional-availability planning, model gateways, and cost governance (token budgeting, caching, chargeback).

3. Context Engineering, Business Ontology & Domain Knowledge

* Mine existing artifacts (legacy code, documentation, wikis, tickets) to bootstrap the customer's knowledge fabric; establish curation, versioning, and freshness practices so context stays accurate as systems and regulations evolve.
* Data preparation for AI: profile and cleanse source data (normalization, deduplication, OCR noise in scanned documents), structure unstructured content, and curate versioned datasets — including synthetic data where appropriate — for retrieval, evaluation, and fine-tuning.
* Data protection in AI pipelines: de-identification, PII masking, and redaction for data used in prompts, retrieval corpora, and evaluations; data lineage and access controls aligned to insurance privacy and regulatory requirements.
* Metadata management and data governance: business glossaries, data catalogs, and lineage that keep the ontology, retrieval corpora, and datasets trustworthy and traceable as systems evolve.
* Apply prompt engineering rigor: few-shot examples, chain-of-thought, structured output design, prompt versioning, and evaluation against golden datasets.

Required Qualifications

* 14–18 years of proven experience in technology leadership / principal or application architect roles on enterprise-scale, distributed multi-tier systems.
* Strong architecture pedigree: n-tier, microservices, and event-driven architecture (EDA) design — including messaging/streaming platforms (Kafka or cloud-native equivalents) — enterprise integration, application maintenance and solution delivery, API design and management, and cloud-native delivery on AWS, Azure, or GCP (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS, containers, CI/CD).
* Deep expertise in at least one major enterprise stack (Java/Spring, .NET, Python, or Node.js) with breadth across others; working proficiency in Python for GenAI development.
* Demonstrable agentic GenAI delivery: at least one agent-assisted engineering or LLM-based solution taken into production or a serious enterprise pilot — able to walk through the architecture, trade-offs, and measured outcomes.
* Practical, current knowledge of multi-agent design, MCP, RAG variants (hybrid search with re-ranking, agentic RAG, RAG over code and structured data), embeddings/vector search, prompt and context engineering, evaluation harnesses and guardrails, and LLM limitations (hallucination, context-window constraints, cost/latency, data privacy).
* Experience modelling business domains and processes: ontologies, taxonomies, or knowledge graphs; state machines and lifecycle models; and the metadata practices that keep them current.
* Experience leading technology-driven programs — POCs, innovation initiatives, and solution asset development — through to large-scale delivery.
* Experience practicing Design Thinking and Systems Thinking in real-world scenarios.
* Outstanding client-facing communication: proven experience engaging customer stakeholders on requirements and delivery from an offshore model, and explaining complex technology in an easy-to-understand way.

  
**Skills**

**Mandatory Skills :** Architecture Governance

 **About LTM**  
LTM is an AI-centric global technology services company and the Business Creativity partner to the world’s largest and most disruptive enterprises. We bring human insights and intelligent systems together to help clients create greater value at the intersection of technology and domain expertise. Our capabilities span integrated operations, transformation, and business AI — enabling new ways of working, new productivity paradigms, and new roads to value. Together with over 87,000 employees across 40 countries and our global network of partners, LTM — a Larsen & Toubro company — owns business outcomes for our clients, helping them not just outperform the market, but to Outcreate it. Candidates shall be solely responsible for verifying the credentials of any agency/consultant that claims to be working with LTM for recruitment. **Product Evangelist**

Solution Engineers play a vital role in bringing the ‘wow-factor’ of Neat to both fellow Neat colleagues and the rest of the world. Solution Engineers are often called upon to help conduct internal training for the sales teams on how to talk about the value of Neat’s technology most effectively, how to do an effective product demo, etc. Solution Engineers might also be asked to co-host webinars or other marketing events and help communicate new product and feature releases to the public.

**Compensation**

Solution Engineers are officially part of the Neat Sales organisation and are compensated via a Base Pay / Salary + sales achievement bonus.

Solution Engineer candidates will have a strong professional background in videoconferencing and commercial audio-visual technologies. 08c4e823.description:
**About Us**
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
  
  
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
  
  
Available Locations
  
  

* Bengaluru, India
* India

**About The Role**
The Principal Partner Solution Engineer (PSE) is a high-impact, strategic technical sales leader responsible for end-to-end technical lifecycle and enablement of the assigned partners, managing both pre-sales and post-sales engineering activities. In this role, you will act as the single technical point of contact as the trusted advisory for your assigned partners, driving technical validation during the sales cycle, architecting their delivery readiness and ensuring ongoing Partner Success.
  
  
The role focuses heavily on driving value-based solution selling to accelerate the adoption of Cloudflare platform with focus on One (SASE/SSE) and AI Infrastructure (Workers AI / AI Gateway). By cultivating deeply technical champions within the partner organization, aligning architectures to tangible business outcomes, optimizing post-sales delivery and building joint managed services offering, you will directly expand and influence the pipeline to maximize Partner-Influenced Opportunity (PIO) revenue.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Pre-Sales Engineering & Champion Building
* Technical Alignment, Discovery & Enablement: Own the technical relationship with Partners to align on building joint Go-To-Market (GTM) strategies. Align, build, and accelerate partner technical capabilities, enabling them to lead deep technical discovery and architectural design to independently sell scalable solutions leveraging the Cloudflare Platform with a strong focus on AI and Cloudflare One (CF1).
* Technical Account Plan Ownership: Own and drive the end-to-end Technical Account Plan (TAP) for assigned strategic partners. Act as the primary architect mapping partner business goals to technical execution milestones, ensuring continuous alignment on CF1 and AI adoption targets.
* Building Technical Champions: Identify, enable, and cultivate key technical advocates and "Champions" within the partner organization to scale Cloudflare expertise independently, generate Partner-Influenced Opportunities (PIO), and empower them to deliver high-value professional services around Zero Trust and AI application security.
* Driving PIO via Next-Gen Architectures: Collaborate with sales teams to proactively source, qualify, and expand PIO through strategic architectural alignment, focusing on migrating legacy network architectures to CF1 and integrating secure AI solutions.
* Deal Support & Qualification: Enable partners' technical validation, proof-of-concept (PoC), demo, pipeline generation, and pipeline acceleration capabilities. Identify joint pursuit accounts, facilitate strategic technical account planning, and deliver cutting-edge solution architecture sessions for Named Partners
* Accelerate Services Delivery
* ASD Partner Journey Ownership: Own the ASD partner journey to ensure partners possess the advanced capabilities required to deploy, manage, and support the Cloudflare platform and AI application workloads seamlessly.
* Joint Services Offering Acceleration with strong focus on CF1 and A1: Build and co-develop joint services catalogues with key partners, accelerating the creation and launch of their own Cloudflare-focused services offerings, managed CF1 SASE practices, and AI security assessments.
* Service Monetization & Performance Metrics: Enable partners to embed CF1 and Workers AI capabilities into their own managed security portfolios to shorten time-to-market, protect client AI pipelines, and maximize profitability. Develop, manage, and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure and improve the effectiveness of these partner service deliveries
* Technical Account Management & Architectural Health: Act as the escalated technical point of contact to ensure long-term architectural health, utilizing telemetry and proactive design to move the partner relationship from reactive to strategics for Cloudflare.
* Automation AI Agents & Continuous Innovation
* Leverage Autonomous AI Tools: Champion the use of Cloudflare OS and AI tools (Agent PAT and Agent Echo) to automate standard, repeatable technical tasks, optimizing operational efficiency and freeing up bandwidth for high-touch, strategic partner engagements.
* AI & CF1 Product Enhancement Feedback Loop: Engage partner champions in the Partner Technical Advisory Council (PTAC) to give them early access to beta software, capture raw product feedback, and drive joint co-innovation on CF1 features and emerging AI products.
* Cross-Functional Enablement: Participate in continuous cross-training programs to maintain peak proficiency in both pre-sales scoping and post-sales service deployment across the entire Cloudflare One and AI ecosystem.

**Desirable Skills, Knowledge, And Experience**

* 8+ years of technical, partner-facing experience (e.g., Systems Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Technical Account Manager) in cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or networking.
* Strong technical depth in Cloudflare One (CF1) or equivalent SASE/SSE architectures, Zero Trust, DNS, and application security, alongside hands-on familiarity with AI deployment, AI Gateway, LLM orchestration frameworks, or vector databases.
* Proven track record of developing technical talent or building "champion" programs within partner organizations, specifically driving adoption of complex cloud networks and AI technologies.
* Enterprise Architecture & Project Management: Deep understanding of enterprise IT, multi-cloud, and hybrid cloud environment while managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to manage the technical lifecycle of a deal from initial pre-sales discovery and CF1/AI PIO generation through post-sale service delivery.
* Strong communication skills with a track record of presenting complex CF1 architectures and AI-driven use cases to partner leadership and technical teams alike.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**What Makes Cloudflare Special?**
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
  
  
**Project Galileo**
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
  
  
**Athenian Project**
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
  
  
**1.1.1.1**
: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
  
  
Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!
  
  
Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.
  
  
This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.
  
  
Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

* Facilitates design reviews and walkthroughs.
* Analyzes benefits and drawbacks of specific software designs and architecture.

: Knowledge of the concepts, processes and technologies of application modernization; ability to design, develop and deploy modernized applications in various business scenarios.

* Creates and customizes cloud application modernization plans based on specific business requirements.
* Consults on security issues and problems regarding application migration.
* Coaches others on the modernization approach for microservice based application.
* Leads discussions on the challenges and risks in developing cloud-native based applications.
* Provides insights on complex technical problems of co-existence of legacy and new application systems.

Knowledge of Architecture Modeling; ability to develop and modify enterprise architecture through conceptual, logical and physical approaches.

* Consults on architecture framework design; verifies operational objectives for each framework design procedure.
* Determines corresponding indicators for each technology layer and evaluates the operational performance of each layer.
* Decides on specific roles and responsibilities of engineers within business, information and data architecture modeling.
* Coordinates materials for architecture design modeling.
* Evaluates technology product roles and strengths within the project and locates appropriate technology providers based on results.

90ada23e.title: Solution Architect - Technology & Innovation
90ada23e.description:
**About Role**

The TNI Solution Architect is a versatile, highly skilled technology generalist responsible for shaping and delivering enterprise architecture across Convatec’s innovation, infrastructure, and platform portfolio.

This role is broad and hands-on, supporting initiatives such as:

* Cloud and on-premise hosting architecture
* Server migrations, data centre transitions, and re-platforming
* Custom-built applications and bespoke software solutions
* Database migrations and optimisation
* Enterprise integration and middleware patterns
* Legacy system modernization
* Evaluation and POCs of emerging technologies
* R&D, innovation pilots and rapid architectural prototyping

The Solution Architect will work closely with the TNI leadership team, engineering groups, security, infrastructure, business stakeholders, and third-party partners to ensure scalable, secure, and future-ready architectural outcomes.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Lead solution architecture for Technology & Innovation (R&D) initiatives spanning custom development, infrastructure, hosting environments, cloud platforms, on-premise systems, database transitions, and enterprise integrations.
* Design and document high-quality solution design artefacts for a wide range of technology solutions, from infrastructure modernization to custom application builds.
* Architect cloud-based and hybrid hosting environments (Azure preferred), including servers, networks, load balancing, security controls, and performance optimization.
* Support server moves, application re-hosting, OS upgrades, lifecycle transitions and re-platforming activities.
* Evaluate and design on-premise architecture for solutions that require local hosting, regulatory compliance, or low-latency demands.
* Lead database migration strategies, including SQL, Oracle, MySQL, NoSQL, and legacy database modernisation.
* Provide architectural guidance on integration patterns such as API-led connectivity, microservices, ESB, event-driven architectures, middleware, and GraphQL.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure solutions are delivered according to architectural standards and security-by-design principles.
* Identify technology gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities across existing environments.
* Lead or support technology pilots, hackathons, emerging-technology experiments, and rapid prototyping for the Technology & Innovation (R&D) organisation.
* Act as Technical Design Authority (TDA) for assigned Technology & Innovation (R&D) projects.
* Ensure alignment with Convatec’s privacy, security, regulatory, and operational frameworks.
* Work with platform providers, hosting partners, and system integrators to understand product roadmaps, patterns, and best practices.
* Contribute to the future-state architecture vision for Technology & Innovation (R&D) and broader enterprise technology domains.

**Key Requirements**

* Min 5 year's experience in related field of Technology & Innovation; background in Medical Devices/Manufacturing industry is highly preferred
* Broad solution architecture experience covering infrastructure, platforms, cloud, integration, and custom software development.
* Regulations and standards like HIPPA, etc.,
* Experience with on-premise hosting, data centre operations, server migration planning, load balancing, failover, backup/DR and hybrid environments.
* Strong background in custom-built software, including solution design, application architecture, and modern development frameworks.
* Experience with database migrations, optimizations, and cross-platform transitions (SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, Postgres, MongoDB, etc.).
* Knowledge of enterprise integration including REST APIs, SOAP, GraphQL, messaging queues, ESB, middleware, event streaming.
* Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and application modernization patterns.
* Experience writing HLA/HLD documentation that guides engineering teams through delivery.
* Strong communicator comfortable working with PMs, BAs, engineering leads, infrastructure
* Experience evaluating emerging technologies and conducting POCs.

**Technical competencies**

* Strong understanding of architecture modelling standards such as C4, ArchiMate, and system context modelling.
* Knowledge of Windows Server, Linux, containerisation, virtualisation (VMware, Hyper-V, Azure VM), and networking fundamentals.
* Familiarity with scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python) to support automation and troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of IT governance, compliance, security frameworks and operational standards.
* Good understanding of SDLC practices (Agile, DevOps, Waterfall) and the ability to work across them.

At Convatec, we’re pioneering trusted medical solutions to improve the lives we touch. If you’re ready to make a real impact, apply today and help us bring our Forever Caring promise to life.

A formal recruitment process is required for all our opportunities prior to any offer of employment. This will include an interview confirmed by an official Convatec email address.

If you receive a suspicious approach over social media, text message, email or phone call about recruitment at Convatec, do not disclose any personal information or pay any fees whatsoever. If you’re unsure, please contact us at careers@Convatec.com.

**Equal opportunities**

Convatec provides equal employment opportunities for all current employees and applicants for employment. This policy means that no one will be discriminated against because of race, religion, creed, color, national origin, nationality, citizenship, ancestry, sex, age, marital status, physical or mental disability, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, genetic predisposing characteristics or any other basis prohibited by law.

**Notice to Agency and Search Firm Representatives**

Convatec is not accepting unsolicited resumes from agencies and/or search firms for this job posting. Resumes submitted to any Convatec employee by a third party agency and/or search firm without a valid written and signed search agreement, will become the sole property of Convatec. No fee will be paid if a candidate is hired for this position as a result of an unsolicited agency or search firm referral. Thank you.

**Already a Convatec employee?**

**If you are an active employee at Convatec, please do not apply here. Go to the Career Worklet on your Workday home page and View "Convatec Internal Career Site - Find Jobs". Thank you!**

**About Convatec**

**Pioneering trusted medical solutions to improve the lives we touch:**

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company, focused on solutions for the management of chronic conditions, with leading positions in Advanced Wound Care, Ostomy Care, Continence Care, and Infusion Care. With over 10,000 colleagues, we provide products and services in around 90 countries, united by a promise to be forever caring. Our solutions provide a range of benefits, from infection prevention, treatment for hard to heal wounds, at-risk skin and ulcerated tissue to supporting debilitating conditions, improved patient outcomes and reduced care costs. Convatec's revenues in 2025 were over $2 billion. The company is a constituent of the FTSE 100 Index (LSE:CTEC). To learn more please visit: http://www.convatecgroup.com.

Business Architect

Identify opportunities to deliver tangible business value by assessing the current state, capturing high-level requirements, and defining business solutions. Translate business needs into technology-enabled solutions and operating models. Support transformation by developing business cases and guiding implementation of key initiatives.

NA

Summary:
  
  
As an OTM Consultant, you will lead and deliver Oracle Transportation Management (OTM) solutions for global clients. This role demands strong functional and technical expertise in OTM, experience in end-to-end implementations, and the ability to work independently or as part of a team. You will collaborate with stakeholders to design optimized solutions, configure OTM modules, and ensure successful project delivery.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Lead or participate in full lifecycle OTM implementation projects, including requirement gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, and deployment.
* Configure OTM modules such as Order Management, Shipment Management, Execution & Visibility, Finance, and FTI.
* Develop and maintain automation agents, workflows, and custom events. Perform functional and technical analysis, troubleshoot issues, and optimize system performance.
* Support OTM Cloud implementations and on-premise to cloud migration activities.
* Manage integrations with ERP/WMS systems and external partners.
* Prepare functional documentation, process flows, and configuration guides.
* Act as a solution lead, guiding junior consultants and ensuring adherence to best practices. Collaborate in Agile/DevOps environments, contributing to CI/CD pipelines and version control processes.

Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* 6–12 years of experience in Oracle Transportation Management (OTM), with at least 2–3 full lifecycle implementations.
* Strong knowledge of OTM functional configurations and technical architecture.
* Hands-on experience with SQL, PL/SQL, and OTM-related data structures.
* Expertise in OTM Cloud, automation agents, and customizations. Familiarity with integration frameworks, external distance/rate engines, and BI Publisher reporting.
* Strong understanding of logistics and supply chain processes. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Additional Information:
  
  

* Good to have: Certifications in Oracle OTM or related SCM modules, experience in performance tuning and optimization of OTM configurations, exposure to 3PL/4PL logistics environments and freight forwarding business, knowledge of DevOps pipelines and Agile methodologies.
* The candidate should have 6-12 years of experience in Oracle SCM Transportation Management.
* This position is open at multiple Accenture locations.
* 15 years full time education is required.

dc3649e2.title: DE - AE- AI Architect-SM-GDS04
dc3649e2.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior AI Architect**
**Experience**

* 15+ years overall; 8+ years in Java/J2EE; 2+ years in AI/GenAI delivery

**Role focus**

* AI-led modernization of enterprise Java platforms and creation of scalable, secure AI solutions

**The opportunity**
We are seeking a Senior AI Architect who combines deep Java/J2EE architecture expertise with hands-on AI and Generative AI delivery experience. The role will shape AI-first enterprise solutions, embed intelligent capabilities into existing Java estates, and guide clients from experimentation through secure, production-scale adoption.
  
  
The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of enterprise architecture, product engineering, cloud-native modernization and applied AI. They will define target architectures, make technology decisions, lead engineering teams, and advise senior stakeholders on how AI can create measurable business and engineering outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI and solution architecture**

* Define end-to-end architectures for AI-enabled enterprise applications, from data ingestion and retrieval through model orchestration, inference, APIs, user experience and production operations.
* Architect Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, knowledge graph, multimodal and agentic AI solutions aligned to business workflows.
* Design multi-agent systems / skills, tool-use patterns and orchestration approaches, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) where relevant.
* Establish architecture blueprints, reusable patterns, non-functional requirements and technology guardrails for scalable, secure and responsible AI adoption.
* Evaluate models, frameworks, data stores and cloud AI services based on quality, latency, security, portability, operability and cost.

**Java/J2EE engineering and modernization**

* Architect enterprise solutions using Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security and RESTful APIs.
* Integrate LLM-powered services, copilots and AI agents into existing Java applications and business workflows through well-governed APIs and event-driven patterns.
* Decompose monolithic applications into modular services and define modernization pathways that introduce AI without compromising business continuity.
* Design microservices, event-driven and distributed architectures using technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ, container platforms and API management.
* Guide engineering teams on code quality, design patterns, performance, resilience, observability, security and maintainability.

**Cloud, LLMOps and production engineering**

* Design and deploy AI solutions on Azure, AWS or GCP using appropriate managed AI services and cloud-native components.
* Establish CI/CD, DevSecOps, MLOps and LLMOps practices covering prompt, model and configuration versioning; automated testing; deployment; monitoring; evaluation and rollback.
* Define AI quality and evaluation frameworks for relevance, groundedness, safety, latency, reliability and cost.
* Implement observability across application, model and agent layers, and drive continuous improvement using telemetry and user feedback.
* Lead the transition from proof of concept to hardened, scalable production deployment.

**Governance, security and responsible AI**

* Embed privacy, data governance, access control, content safety, model security, auditability and Responsible AI requirements into solution design.
* Define controls for prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, unsafe outputs, model misuse and third-party model risk.
* Partner with security, risk, legal and compliance stakeholders to align AI solutions with enterprise policies and applicable regulatory obligations.
* Drive cost transparency and FinOps practices for model usage, infrastructure and multi-cloud AI workloads.

**Consulting, leadership and capability building**

* Lead discovery workshops, architecture assessments and design sessions with business and technology stakeholders.
* Translate business goals into AI roadmaps, solution options, implementation plans and clear value cases.
* Act as a trusted advisor to client leadership and communicate architecture choices, trade-offs, risks and outcomes in executive-ready language.
* Provide technical leadership for pursuits, proposals, solutioning and estimation, including architecture narratives and delivery models.
* Lead and mentor cross-functional teams of architects, Java engineers, AI engineers, data scientists and platform specialists.
* Create reusable accelerators, reference implementations, knowledge assets and engineering standards for the EAT competency.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Education: BE/BTech/MCA or equivalent degree in computer science, engineering or a related discipline.
* Overall experience: 15+ years in software architecture, engineering and enterprise solution delivery.
* Java/J2EE depth: 8+ years designing and delivering enterprise-grade Java/J2EE applications, with strong Spring ecosystem experience.
* Architecture depth: 5+ years in microservices, distributed systems, API-led and event-driven architecture.
* AI delivery: 2+ years of hands-on architecture and implementation experience in AI/ML/GenAI initiatives, with evidence of production or enterprise-scale delivery.
* Leadership: Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and owning architecture and delivery outcomes.
* Consulting: Strong client engagement, workshop facilitation, presales, storytelling and senior stakeholder communication skills.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**
**Capability & Expected proficiency**

* Enterprise engineering - Java 8/11/17+, J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, REST APIs, microservices, design patterns, distributed systems
* Integration and platforms - API management, Kafka/RabbitMQ, event-driven architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, service observability
* GenAI and agentic AI - LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, semantic and hybrid search, AI agents, multi-agent orchestration, context engineering
* AI frameworks - Hands-on exposure to relevant frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI or Haystack
* Data and retrieval - SQL/NoSQL, vector databases such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS or equivalent; knowledge graphs such as Neo4j
* Cloud AI - At least one of Azure OpenAI / Azure AI, AWS Bedrock / SageMaker, or Google Vertex AI, with working awareness of the other major clouds
* Operationalization - CI/CD, DevSecOps, MLOps/LLMOps, model and prompt lifecycle, evaluation, monitoring, tracing and production support
* Security and governance - Identity and access, OAuth/OIDC or SAML, data protection, AI safety, Responsible AI, model risk and secure AI service integration

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Python and AI service development using FastAPI or Flask, alongside the primary Java/J2EE engineering background.
* Fine-tuning concepts, model optimization, quantization, open-source models and multimodal AI.
* GraphRAG, Knowledge-Augmented Generation, enterprise knowledge platforms and advanced retrieval/evaluation patterns.
* Workflow orchestration or BPM platforms such as Camunda, Airflow or Prefect.
* Infrastructure as Code and platform engineering using tools such as Terraform and GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
* Experience across regulated industries and familiarity with enterprise privacy, security and compliance expectations.
* Relevant cloud, architecture, Java or AI certifications; contributions to internal accelerators, open-source projects or technical communities.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

8dff4150.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Kinaxis Configuration**
**– Lead Business Transformation Architect**
Join Deloitte’s Enterprise Performance practice as a Manager, Kinaxis, where you will lead digital transformation and optimization initiatives across supply chain planning environments. In this role, you will drive the design, configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization of Kinaxis solutions for complex client needs. You will work with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable functional solutions, lead delivery of quality work products within project timelines, and support implementation activities across the solution lifecycle.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, Kinaxis on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Leading Kinaxis implementation activities across requirements analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization
* Translating business requirements into functional specifications, process flows, user stories, and solution design artifacts
* Leading coordination with client stakeholders and onsite/offshore teams to support workshops, issue resolution, and delivery of project work products
* Driving data integration, legacy data conversion, and data management activities across spreadsheets, source systems, and planning platforms
* Supporting solution validation across development, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and production deployment phases

**The team**
The Enterprise Performance team leverages deep industry knowledge, strong analytical skills, and practical approaches to address clients’ toughest business challenges. Our professionals as part of the Supply Chain Network Operations (SCNO) service line within Enterprise Performance focus on helping organizations achieve sustainable competitive advantage throughout their operations, spanning product development, planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution. We excel at translating strategic objectives into tangible, measurable outcomes at the operational level. By aligning high-level goals with frontline execution, we ensure our clients realize real value and improved performance across every stage of their supply chain and operations.
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST as per business requirements
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 12+ years of experience in Kinaxis implementation, configuration, enhancement, or support activities
* Experience with data integration, legacy data conversion, spreadsheet-based data handling, or data management activities
* Experience leading functional and technical workstreams across onsite and offshore delivery teams
* Experience facilitating client workshops, solution design sessions, or deployment activities for supply chain planning solutions
* Experience supporting validation across development, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and production deployment phases
* Experience supporting business process design across supply planning, inventory management, or supplier collaboration
* BE/B.Tech./M.C.A./M.Tech. degree or equivalent from an accredited university

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience in automobiles or consumer products industry environments
* Experience with JDA (Blue Yonder), o9 Solutions, OMP, or Logility Voyager
* Experience with software implementation life cycle activities including business requirements, functional specifications, test planning, user training, and deployment
* Experience creating test plans, test cases, and functional testing documentation
* Experience supporting issue resolution and user acceptance testing activities
* Experience developing tools, training materials, or knowledge assets for project teams
