a9095356.title: Senior Associate Cloud SRE - Azure & AWS
a9095356.description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title: Senior Associate Cloud SRE – Azure & AWS**
**Educations: Any Graduate**
**Experience: 5+years**
**Location: Mumbai**
**Key Skills: Azure & AWS - We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer to deliver tier two cloud operations managed services support Azure environments. This role combines advanced troubleshooting and operational excellence with proactive reliability engineering, focusing on maintaining 24x7x365 service availability while continuously improving automation and operational efficiency across multi-cloud infrastructure.**
**Role Summary:**
As a Site Reliability Engineer supporting multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS and Azure), you will manage complex operational challenges and escalations while implementing reliability best practices across production systems. You will work collaboratively with customer teams and senior engineers to ensure system stability, automate operational workflows, and maintain comprehensive observability. This is a delivery-focused role requiring both advanced technical execution and operational ownership across cloud platforms.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities:**
**Tier 2 Multi-Cloud Operations & Managed Services**
**AWS Operations:**

* Provide 24x7x365 tier two support and escalation handling for AWS environments
* Execute complex operational tasks including:
* Patching and managing Amazon Machine Images (AMIs)
* Creating and configuring EC2 instances and RDS databases
* Managing IAM roles, users, and policies
* Configuring S3 bucket policies and Access Control Lists (ACLs)
* Opening and managing network routes (VPC, subnets, security groups)
* Restoring snapshots and database backups to lower environments
* Increasing disk sizes (EBS volumes) and managing storage optimization
* Implementing proper tagging for environment identification and cost allocation
* Managing logs archiving using CloudWatch Logs and S3

**Azure Operations:**

* Provide equivalent tier two support for Azure cloud environments
* Execute Azure-specific operational tasks including:
* Managing and updating Azure Virtual Machine images
* Creating and configuring Azure Virtual Machines and Azure SQL databases
* Managing Azure Active Directory (AAD) identities, roles, and role-based access control (RBAC)
* Configuring Azure Storage account policies and access controls
* Managing Virtual Networks, Network Security Groups (NSGs), and route tables
* Restoring VM snapshots and database backups to lower environments
* Managing disk resizing and Azure Managed Disks optimization
* Implementing Azure resource tagging and cost management
* Managing log archiving using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics

**Cross-Cloud Responsibilities:**

* Handle escalations from tier one support with deep technical analysis across both platforms
* Provide root cause analysis for complex incidents in multi-cloud environments
* Implement consistent operational standards across AWS and Azure
* Support hybrid cloud connectivity and integration scenarios

**Reliability & Incident Management:**

* Implement and maintain Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) across AWS and Azure in collaboration with senior engineers and customer stakeholders
* Lead tier two incident response, performing advanced troubleshooting and resolution on both cloud platforms
* Conduct thorough post-incident analysis with actionable remediation plans
* Reduce reactive work by improving runbooks, alert configurations, and standard operating procedures for both clouds
* Apply reliability engineering best practices with oversight and review
* Mentor tier one engineers during incident response across multi-cloud scenarios

**Automation & Infrastructure as Code:**

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments on AWS and Azure
* Automate complex operational tasks including patching, backups, and environment provisioning across both platforms
* Develop infrastructure automation using Terraform for multi-cloud environments
* Create sophisticated scripts and tooling to eliminate manual toil and improve operational efficiency
* Implement Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates or Bicep for Azure-specific automation
* Follow established patterns and contribute continuous improvements
* Document automation processes for knowledge sharing across cloud platforms

**Containerization & Deployment:**

* Deploy and operate containerized workloads using Docker on AWS services (ECS, EKS) and Azure services (AKS, Azure Container Instances)
* Support container reliability through proper health checks, autoscaling configurations, and resource management on both platforms
* Implement safe deployment patterns (canary deployments, blue/green deployments) across AWS and Azure
* Troubleshoot complex containerization and orchestration issues in multi-cloud Kubernetes environments
* Follow and enhance established containerization standards across both cloud providers

**Observability & Performance:**

* Configure and maintain comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting systems across AWS CloudWatch and Azure Monitor
* Leverage observability data to identify issues and lead root cause analysis in multi-cloud environments
* Contribute to performance tuning and cost optimization initiatives across both platforms
* Ensure proper instrumentation and telemetry across AWS and Azure environments
* Identify patterns and trends to prevent future incidents
* Build custom dashboards and reports using CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, and third-party tools (Datadog, Grafana)

**Collaboration & Customer Engagement:**

* Work closely with customer development and operations teams to improve system operability across cloud platforms
* Participate in design reviews and reliability assessments for multi-cloud architectures
* Communicate technical concepts, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders
* Provide regular operational updates and service reports covering both AWS and Azure
* Act as technical liaison between customers and internal engineering teams

**Required Qualifications & Experience:**

* 5 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, SRE, or production operations roles
* Proven experience operating production systems in AWS OR Azure (deep expertise in one required)
* Working knowledge or exposure to the secondary cloud platform (ability to learn and support)
* Demonstrated experience managing containerized applications in production
* Experience delivering managed services or supporting customer-facing infrastructure
* Track record of handling complex technical escalations in cloud environments
* Technical Skills - Primary Cloud Platform (AWS OR Azure)

**For AWS-Primary Candidates:**

* AWS Services (Expert): Deep knowledge of EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, Lambda, and related services
* AWS Networking (Expert): Strong experience with VPCs, subnets, security groups, route tables, and VPN/Direct Connect
* AWS Storage (Expert): Proficiency with EBS, S3, and backup/restore strategies
* AWS Containers (Expert): Hands-on experience with ECS, EKS, or Fargate
* Azure (Foundational): Basic understanding of Azure services with willingness to learn; exposure to Azure VMs, Storage, or networking is a plus

**For Azure-Primary Candidates:**

* Azure Services (Expert): Deep knowledge of Azure VMs, Azure SQL, Storage Accounts, Azure AD, Virtual Networks, Azure Monitor
* Azure Networking (Expert): Strong experience with VNets, NSGs, Application Gateway, Azure Firewall, and ExpressRoute
* Azure Storage (Expert): Proficiency with Managed Disks, Blob Storage, and Azure Backup
* Azure Containers (Expert): Hands-on experience with AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service) and Azure Container Instances
* AWS (Foundational): Basic understanding of AWS services with willingness to learn; exposure to EC2, S3, or VPC is a plus

**Technical Skills - Cross-Platform (All Candidates)**

* Infrastructure as Code: Proficiency with Terraform (preferred) or CloudFormation/ARM templates
* CI/CD: Experience building and maintaining automated deployment pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI)
* Scripting/Programming: Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages
* Containerization: Strong Docker skills and Kubernetes experience
* Monitoring & Logging: Experience with cloud-native monitoring tools and/or third-party observability platforms (Datadog, Splunk, ELK, Grafana)
* Version Control: Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows
* Troubleshooting: Advanced diagnostic and problem-solving capabilities

**Operational Capabilities:**

* Experience with 24x7 operations and tier two escalation support
* Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills
* Understanding of networking concepts, security best practices, and compliance requirements
* Familiarity with backup/restore procedures and disaster recovery planning
* Ability to work under pressure during critical incidents
* Experience coordinating across distributed teams
* Willingness and ability to quickly learn the secondary cloud platform

**Preferred Qualifications & Certifications:**

* AWS Certifications (for AWS-primary): Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps Administrator, or DevOps Engineer Professional
* Azure Certifications (for Azure-primary): Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) or Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
* Cloud-agnostic certifications (Terraform Associate, CKA, or SRE Foundation)

**Additional Preferred Experience:**

* Any hands-on experience with both AWS and Azure (even if limited in one)
* Experience with Kubernetes in production environments
* Prior consulting or managed services provider experience
* Experience with hybrid cloud or cloud migration projects
* Experience with configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, Puppet)

5dd43a1a.title: Delivery Lead
5dd43a1a.description:
***Creospan is a growing tech collective of makers, shakers, and problem solvers, offering solutions today that will propel businesses into a better tomorrow. “Tomorrow’s ideas, built today!” In addition to being able to work alongside equally brilliant and motivated developers, our consultants appreciate the opportunity to learn and apply new skills and methodologies to different clients and industries.***

**Location:**
Pune, Maharashtra (hybrid; at least 3 days a week in office)

**Working hours:**
Partial overlap with US business hours to work with client stakeholders

**Experience:**
15+ years in IT services, with the last 5 years spent leading delivery for a banking client

**Reports to:**
Delivery Director / Account Delivery Head – Banking

**Team size:**
50–150 people

**About the role**

The Delivery Lead owns day-to-day delivery, client satisfaction and account health for one strategic banking client, run from our Pune delivery center. You will be the bank's main delivery contact and accountable for every commitment the team makes.

You will lead a team across development, testing and support. You will also find ways to grow the account and keep delivery compliant with the bank's security and regulatory requirements.

**Key responsibilities**

**Delivery management**

* Own end-to-end delivery of all projects for the bank.
* Run delivery governance: daily and weekly status reviews, monthly steering committees and QBR inputs.
* Prepare and present weekly status reports to the customer, covering progress on deliverables, milestones, risks, issues and next steps.
* Publish monthly delivery reports covering SLA and KPI performance, deliverables completed, quality metrics, resource status and improvement actions.
* Track SLAs, KPIs, milestones and risks. Step in early on red or amber projects and lead recovery.
* Drive automation, AI-assisted engineering and productivity improvements.

**Client relationship**

* Work with US-based stakeholders during overlapping hours for status calls, planning sessions and escalations.
* Serve as the main delivery contact for the bank's stakeholders, from IT managers to heads of technology.
* Build trust through predictable delivery, clear reporting and proactive communication.
* Manage escalations to closure and keep CSAT at or above target.

**Account financials and growth**

* Manage account revenue, margin, utilization, pyramid and monthly billing accuracy.
* Support forecasting, change requests and SOW renewals.
* Identify new scope and work with account management and pre-sales on proposals.

**People leadership**

* Lead and mentor project managers, scrum masters and technical leads.
* Plan resourcing, hiring and onboarding with HR and the resource management team.
* Build a motivated team with clear goals, regular feedback and strong retention.

**Risk, security and compliance**

* Ensure delivery meets the bank's and regulators' requirements.
* Maintain information security, data privacy and audit readiness.
* Manage contract compliance and delivery risk.

**Required qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.
* 15+ years in IT services, with the last 5 years spent leading delivery for a banking client.
* Experience leading teams of 50+ and managing an account or programmes.
* Hands-on experience delivering for clients in the US.
* Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum, SAFe, DevOps and Waterfall.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure.
* Working knowledge of APIs and microservices, data and analytics, and test automation.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.

**Banking domain expertise**

* Experience in Trade Settlement, Wealth Management, Accounting and Asset Servicing.
* Understanding of US market practices such as T+1 settlement, DTCC processes, and payments (ACH, Fedwire, SWIFT).
* Exposure to TCS BaNCS would be helpful. Familiarity with other platforms common in US banking, such as FIS, Fiserv, Broadridge or SS&C, is a plus.

**Preferred qualifications**

* PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM/SAFe or ITIL certification.
* Experience with transitions or core banking modernization programmes.
* Experience with Core Java and React is a plus.
* Prior experience working from Pune or another major Indian delivery hub.

6f9e5518.title: Technical Program Manager - Engineering
6f9e5518.description:
What You'll Do
  
  
Avalara is building the future of tax compliance infrastructure, operating at a massive scale that processes billions of transactions for hundreds of thousands of customers globally. As a Technical Program Manager in Engineering, you will bring disciplined, data-informed, and AI-enabled program leadership to our most critical initiatives.
  
  
You’ll act as a force multiplier for engineering velocity, connecting strategy to execution across our global teams spanning Product, Architecture, Platform Engineering, Security, and Cloud Operations. This role is essential to our ability to ship at scale with predictability and visibility, as you will build the analytical infrastructure that makes delivery reliable and communicate complex technical realities with the clarity needed for confident leadership decisions.
  
  
You will join the Engineering Operations team, reporting to the
**Sr Director, Technical Program Management**
. This role is
  
  
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**

* Drive end-to-end planning, execution, dependency mapping, and delivery of mission-critical, multi-team engineering programs.
* Proactively surface hidden technical assumptions, resolve complex inter-service dependencies, and evaluate architectural trade-offs to sustain delivery predictability and unblock teams before risks become incidents.
* Own milestone governance and escalation frameworks that keep programs aligned across global time zones and competing priorities.
* Design and optimize Jira ecosystems (filters, JQL, Advanced Roadmaps, boards) to enforce rigorous SDLC hygiene and provide clear operational visibility.
* Prototype and build custom, interactive dashboards and analytical tools using Python, Streamlit, or low-code platforms, leveraging AI-assisted development to accelerate the creation of reporting infrastructure.
* Synthesize multi-layered technical complexity into crisp, executive-ready narratives and roadmaps for VP and C-level audiences.
* Champion the adoption of cutting-edge AI developer tools, intelligent agents, and LLM-assisted workflows to structurally improve planning, analysis, and execution velocity.
* Raise the bar for execution quality by identifying meaningful AI opportunities tied to delivery efficiency, and ensuring AI is applied responsibly, securely, and ethically.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  

* B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related field.
* 8 to 12+ years of Technical Program Management experience in fast-paced, product-based cloud or SaaS environments.
* Demonstrated track record of managing multi-team organizational initiatives across global time zones, with strong experience aligning US and India stakeholders.
* Deep fluency with Jira and Agile/Flow metrics, including expert-level ability to design JQL queries, CFD/Kanban workflows, and delivery KPIs.
* Hands-on experience prototyping and building dashboards, scripts, and data tools using Python, Streamlit, JavaScript, or low-code frameworks.
* Familiarity with modern AI coding assistants (such as Cursor, Claude Code, or GitLab Copilot) for personal productivity, automated workflow generation, and applied AI problem-solving.
* Exceptional executive storytelling skills with a proven ability to influence senior leadership through clear, structured, and visually compelling communication.
* Strong technical acumen with the ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs, understand API design, and reason about scaling constraints in distributed SaaS systems.
* High standards of quality, ownership, and accountability, with a demonstrated ability to simplify complexity, drive measurable outcomes, and elevate the performance and AI capability of the teams around you.

Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
  
  
**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

7631a0e7.title: Product Program Manager
7631a0e7.description:
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.

  

If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

  

We’re looking for a **Program Manager** to be part of making this happen.

  

**Position Overview and Objective**

The Program Manager will manage and lead programs to drive the engineering development and implementation process for a subsystem and component of a product or service offering. Involvement lasts throughout all stages of a product’s lifecycle including ideation/concept, modifications, upgrades and maintenance of the product or product line.

  

The Program Manager will manage and lead strategic programs and initiatives within our cybersecurity software and services organization. This role is responsible for planning, executing, and delivering complex programs that align with business objectives, customer needs, and regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate will drive cross-functional collaboration, ensure program alignment with company strategy, and manage risks and dependencies to deliver high-quality security solutions on time and within budget.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Strategic Influence & Thought Leadership – Guides executive decision-making on product strategy, technology investments, and long-term roadmap planning.
* Enterprise-Wide Program Management – Oversees multiple complex initiatives spanning business units, ensuring strategic objectives are met across products and teams.
* Technical Due Diligence – Leads deep dives into system architecture, performance, and scalability to assess risk and feasibility for high-impact initiatives.
* Executive & Stakeholder Alignment – Communicates trade-offs, investment rationales, and progress updates to C-suite and board-level stakeholders.
* Mentorship & Organization Impact – Develops best practices, frameworks, and coaching initiatives to elevate program management capabilities across the company.
* Lead and manage large-scale cybersecurity programs from initiation through completion, ensuring alignment with company objectives.
* Develop and maintain program roadmaps, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring effective coordination across engineering, product management, marketing, legal, sales and customer success teams.
* Oversee program governance, risk management, and compliance with industry security standards and regulations.
* Define and implement best practices for program execution, tracking, and reporting, ensuring visibility and accountability.
* Serves as the primary point of contact for program stakeholders, facilitating communication and alignment across business units.
* Manage budgets, resource allocation, and vendor relationships to optimize program efficiency.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance program execution, team collaboration, and customer satisfaction.
* Serves as the central resource with design, process, manufacturing, test, quality, and marketing as the product(s) move to production and distribution.
* Designs, develops, and manages activities for a specific product or group of products from product definition and planning through production, release, and end of life.
* Coordinate activities of supporting project teams and internal and external development partners.
* Track progress against established plan and makes decisions to alter or update schedule and resource allocation to meet product requirements and development schedule.
* Mentor direct and interdisciplinary team members.
* Champion AI & Automation in Program Management – Identify and implement AI-driven tools and automation workflows to streamline program planning, status reporting, risk tracking, and cross-functional coordination, reducing manual overhead and improving program execution speed.
Drive data-driven insights by leveraging AI-powered analytics and dashboards to proactively surface program health metrics, predict delivery risks, and support executive-level decision-making with real-time program intelligence.  

  

**Experience & Requirements**
-----------------------------

* 8-10 years’ experience in a technical or product role managing large-scale software deployments
* 8-10 years of experience in program / project/ product management, with at least 6 years in software development
* Bachelor’s degree required in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Business, or related field
* Understanding of project and program management skills and methodologies
* Expertise in program management methodologies (Agile, SAFe, etc.) and tools (JIRA, Confluence, Aha!, etc.).
* Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, ensuring effective communication between technical and non-technical teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify risks, dependencies, and optimization opportunities.
* Excellent leadership, negotiation, and change management skills to drive execution and adoption of cybersecurity initiatives.
* Experience communicating and representing work to leadership, framing discussions to gain valuable feedback, and experience working with technical management teams to develop systems, solutions, and products.
* Analytical and problem-solving experience with large-scale systems
* Proficient in building trust and establishing relationships across multi-disciplinary teams.
Aptitude towards establishing and leading teams through multi-disciplinary relationships including product management and engineering to drive product programs.  

  

**Nice to Have**

* PMP, PgMP, or SAFe certification.
* Experience in cybersecurity is a plus.
* Prefer degree in a technical area.
* Experience applying AI tools and automation platforms (e.g., Copilot, Claude, Notion AI, or similar) to enhance program management workflows such as meeting summarization, dependency tracking, and automated reporting.
Demonstrated interest or experience in evaluating and piloting AI/ML-driven solutions within a program or product management context to improve operational efficiency and team productivity.  

  

**On-Camera Policy**

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

  

**About Arctic Wolf**

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2025), Best Places to Work – USA (2021-2025), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – UK (2024-2026), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024-2026). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.

  

**Our Values**

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion, and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.

  

We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance.

  

We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.

  

All **India** wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

* Equity for all employees
* Flexible annual leave, paid holidays and volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
* Fertility support and paid parental leave
Employee Assistance Program  

  

Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodation by emailing recruiting@arcticwolf.com. View our Hiring Page to learn more about our application process.

  

**Security Requirements**

* Conducts duties and responsibilities in accordance with AWN’s Information Security policies, standards, processes, and controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of AWN business information (in accordance with our employee handbook and corporate policies).
* Background checks are required for this position.
* This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”). Please note that, if applicable, an offer for employment will be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations.

cd59a956.title: Assoc Dir Project/Program Manager
cd59a956.description:
**We Are Teva**
We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Teva IT Operations & Architecture – PMO team is looking for a seasoned program manager to lead a large-scale Cloud & Infrastructure migration. The key focus of this role will be in the IT Infrastructure domain specifically for migrating Teva’s primary data centres to cloud and colocation services, enable data-centre and VMware exits and implement Disaster Recovery deployments.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong program leadership with practical infrastructure knowledge, financial discipline, and executive communication. The role requires close coordination across infrastructure, application, business, cybersecurity, quality, facilities, finance, procurement, and external service providers, while maintaining delivery momentum in a highly regulated global environment.
  
  
**How You’ll Spend Your Day**

* Responsible for developing, establishing, and implementing plan and governance model for a large and complex cloud & infrastructure migrations.
* Engage with facilities, business, IT teams and IT leadership to align the plan for the coordinated program
* Direct external service integrators and technology partners, define measurable deliverables, monitor performance, and ensure contractual commitments
* Responsible of identifying the cost parameters and keep track of the budget for the program.
* Issue and manage a Request for Proposal and lead the IT leadership through the RFP lifecycle all the way to negotiating and signing contracts for a managed services model.

**Your Qualification And Experience**

* MSc/B.Tech. /B.E. (Computer Science/IT).
* 12 to 15 years’ experience in managing transformation initiatives involving people, process and technology elements.
* Strong knowledge and hands on experience on cloud migration, colocation solutions and data centre operations, hypervisor solutions.
* Strong knowledge and hands on experience on Disaster Recovery and High Availability solutions
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure and AWS cloud environments
* Project Manager specialized in infrastructure operations including Data Center/Compute Management
* Must have experience managing large managed services programs.
* Good understanding of cloud and related cost optimization/management.
* Good understanding on Infrastructure Hypervisors solutions

0cd44d06.description:
**Brennan. Where true performance thrives.**
At Brennan, we believe that
*how*

*what*
the technology is. We focus on creating real and relevant value for customers with solutions that fit their specific needs and always reflect their true interests. It’s a claim backed by our
**True Performance System**
- a way of working engineered to get us closer, and deliver better, for our customers and their actual experience of technology.
  
  
**Why join Brennan**
True performance for our customers starts with a true belief in our people.
  
  
It’s why we’ve structured our business to help our teams, and their talents, shine bright. It's why we’ve created a workplace where people of all backgrounds, beliefs and experiences are welcomed and empowered. And it’s why we’ve built an organisation where real innovation makes a genuine impact and generates true rewards for our team members.
  
  
**True rewards**
In addition to competitive remuneration, Brennan offers extensive benefits, including:
  
  

* Training and certification bonuses
* Culture Awards that recognise excellence
* Brennan Daredevils - our annual, all-expenses paid trip awarded to our top performers and outstanding contributors
* Vibrant, fun social activities
* Discounted hardware and software
* An environment that embraces learning and development

**PURPOSE OF ROLE**
The Presales Solutions Engineer is a technical-sales focused professional responsible for growing revenue across the Brennan IT portfolio. As a Presales Solutions Engineer you will be responsible for providing pre-sales technical consulting expertise to assist Brennan IT winning new and retaining existing business.
  
  
The Presales Solutions Engineer core role is to provide pre-sales technical insights, solution design and solution support to the Australia Based Pre Sales Team and existing Brennan customers.
  
  
Presales Solutions Engineer will assist in developing technical solutions for existing customers with regards to Managed Services, Hybrid Cloud (IaaS, Azure, AWS), Modern Workplace (M365), Networking & Security and SDWAN. This role will also involve the development of customer facing artifacts, Work Breakdown Structures and Statements of Work (SOW) and the Individual must have the ability to follow the Internal processes for sign off and approvals prior to releasing documentation to the customer.
  
  
An individual who has a generalist technical background with ability a proven ability to problem solve will be key to being successful in this role. A successful Presales Solutions Engineer must also have the ability to understand the customer requirement, develop task based breakdown structures coupled with effort estimations in line with customer outcomes, and collaborate with the Pre Sales Architecture Community to develop and recommend solutions.
  
  
As a Presales Solutions Engineer you will
  
  

* Have an attention to detail and provide a high standard of technical solution design to clients and create SOWs
* Ability to think outside the box when scoping and solutioning outcomes In line with customer objectives and budget
* Support the development of Statement of Work's and follow due process for Internal sign off prior to customer release
* Ability to work across competing priorities and outcomes
* Ability to build relationships with the wider Pre Sales Architecture community and Practice Leads where required
* Support the development of proposals, presentations and technical documentation where required
* Contribute to the Product Development cycle by participating in internal and client Workshops.

**ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Working in collaboration with an Australian Based Pre Sales Architect to produce customer facing artifacts required during the sales process
* Utilising internal systems to create relevant artifacts for generation of Work Breakdown Structure, Managed Services Renewals and Variations and follow process for peer review and technical sign off
* Attending customer meetings to discuss and obtain customer requirement
* Development of a scope of work at the direction of key stakeholder
* Transcribing the technical outcomes and scope to an order form
* Owning and following the Internal process for peer review and approval prior to releasing to customer.
* Working alongside an Australian Based Pre Sale Architect to produce and develop customer artifacts required for a successful sale.
* Coordinating internal teams to inputs required to complete multi solutions proposals
* Maintain an in-depth knowledge of the company’s products and services offerings and methodologies.
* Any other task/duties aligned with your role or in support of your team as advised by your leader.
* Delivery of various pre-sales activities - including responding to customer requests for information, developing and planning conceptual solution presentations and demonstrations, technical/product guidance in meetings etc.

**KEY COMPETENCIES**

* Passion for customer service
* Excellent communication and presentation skills (verbally and in writing)
* Proven experience of scoping and developing solutions
* Experience within an IT solutions business with experience in Cloud Services and IT outsourcing / managed services
* A “trusted advisor” and “project leader” attitude
* Well organised, ability to perform and work well under pressure.
* A willingness to work and adapt to a fast growing & changing environment
* Technical understanding of IaaS and Hybrid Cloud
* Technical understanding of Microsoft Office 365 Suite of technologies including, Endpoint Management, Security and Teams
* Understanding of Cloud Connectivity, Networking and SDWAN technologies
* Understanding of AI and how to apply AI to achieve the required outcomes
* Industry based technical certifications (e.g. Microsoft, , VMWare, EMC, Cisco, HP, Sophos, Fortinet)
* Experience working with Cloud, IaaS and Hosting solutions including products such as Microsoft Azure and Office 365
* Prior experience within an outsourced service delivery environment
* Proven experience and ability to provide consultative guidance combined with previous customer facing Presales and presentation experience
* 5+ years industry experience in professional services or experience in technical service delivery roles

is an equal opportunity employer.

3176d7d4.title: Solutions Engineer, Government
3176d7d4.description:
***Hiring Remotely in Hyderabad.***
**Our Company**
Neat brings people together with beautifully simple, versatile video devices and experiences. By minimizing the physical and virtual divide, we enable everyone to feel more connected, present and understood, however they prefer to work. We aim to make our technologies so intuitive that terms like "in-office" and "remote" will seem obsolete in five years. Neat's pioneering portfolio addresses the needs of today's workplace and natively supports Microsoft Teams, Zoom, and a range of compelling business apps.
  
  
We are an ambitious, accountable, collaborative, responsible, and growing team that fosters an environment where creativity and ingenuity can flourish. We strive to bring out the best in our Neaters and make amazing products and experiences. We are based in Oslo with Neaters working all over the world.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
At Neat, a Solution Engineer serves as the primary product expert and technical resource for the Neat sales teams and partner community. Three main points of focus comprise the majority of a Solution Engineer's responsibilities:
  
  
**Sales Collaboration**
Neat Solution Engineering team with sales and/or partner representatives to ensure that customers and partners understand the value of Neat’s products, design philosophy, and roadmap. An SE will support several Neat sales representatives in customer opportunities, closely align with them on customer strategy, and oversee the technical aspects of product evaluations/proofs of concept.
  
  
**Product Team Ambassador**
Solution Engineers act as the face of our product development team to the customer and partner community. They are responsible for collecting and responding to customer feedback and feature requests, evaluating them based on relevance, and communicating them effectively back to the product team. Also, Solution Engineers are expected to understand Neat’s product and feature roadmap and deliver future-state messaging to partners and customers clearly and effectively.
  
  
**Product Evangelist**
Solution Engineers play a vital role in bringing the ‘wow-factor’ of Neat to both fellow Neat colleagues and the rest of the world. Solution Engineers are often called upon to help conduct internal training for the sales teams on how to talk about the value of Neat’s technology most effectively, how to do an effective product demo, etc. Solution Engineers might also be asked to co-host webinars or other marketing events and help communicate new product and feature releases to the public.
  
  
**Compensation**
Solution Engineers are officially part of the Neat Sales organisation and are compensated via a Base Pay / Salary + sales achievement bonus.
  
  
**Skills Required**
Solution Engineer candidates will have a strong professional background in videoconferencing and commercial audio-visual technologies. Broader knowledge of unified communications and collaboration technologies (web conferencing, IP telephony, etc.) is a plus. Strong communication/presentation skills are highly desirable.
  
  
Founded in 2019, Neat was created to make the meeting space the best it can be. We understand the meeting space better than anyone else and we pour all our energy into every last detail of what we do.

cc1ac353.title: Solutions Architect - (Collection Industry)
cc1ac353.description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a senior **Solutions Architect** -**Collections** to design differentiated commercially viable solutions for clients across debt collections, recoveries, specialty finance, banking, auto lending, utilities, and other credit-led businesses.

  

This role sits at the intersection of collections operations, technology, analytics, AI, compliance, and commercial solutioning. The individual will work closely with Sales, Operations, Technology, Finance, and prospective clients to translate business problems into scalable operating models and compelling solutions.

The role requires someone who understands collections beyond staffing models: portfolio segmentation, treatment strategies, contact optimization, digital collections, agent productivity, compliance, analytics, and the emerging role of AI and automation.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Design**

* Lead solution development for collections RFPs, RFIs, client workshops, and proactive pursuits.
* Diagnose client challenges across delinquency management, recoveries, servicing, and collections operations.
* Design end-to-end operating models covering people, process, technology, analytics, governance, and location strategy.
* Develop solutions across early-stage, late-stage, pre-charge-off, post-charge-off, recoveries, and specialty collections.
* Design segmentation and treatment strategies based on balance, delinquency stage, propensity to pay, customer profile, risk, channel, and regulatory constraints.
* Define appropriate use of voice, SMS, email, digital self-service, payment portals, conversational AI, and agent-assisted channels.
* Identify opportunities to reduce cost-to-collect while improving liquidation, cure rates, right-party contact, and customer outcomes.

  

**AI, Automation & Analytics**

* Incorporate AI and automation into collections operating models.
* Identify opportunities for:

+ AI-powered agent assistance
+ Automated call summarization and dispositioning
+ Interaction analytics and 100% QA
+ Next-best-action and treatment recommendations
+ Propensity-to-pay and contactability models
+ Automated digital collections
+ Compliance monitoring
+ Workflow and back-office automation

* Partner with technology teams to translate business requirements into deployable capabilities.
* Build practical transformation roadmaps rather than technology-led concepts disconnected from operating reality.

  

**Commercial Solutioning**

* Develop business cases quantifying improvements in:

+ Collections effectiveness
+ Cost-to-collect
+ Liquidation and recovery rates
+ Right-party contact
+ Promise-to-pay and kept-promise rates
+ Agent productivity
+ AHT and occupancy
+ Compliance and QA coverage

* Support pricing models including FTE, transaction, contingency, hybrid, and outcome-based constructs.
* Develop transition and transformation assumptions, implementation plans, and benefit realization models.
* Support executive-level client presentations and solution workshops.

  

**Collections Domain Leadership**

* Act as a subject-matter expert for collections within the Solutions organization.
* Bring external market knowledge on collections practices, technology platforms, regulatory developments, and emerging operating models.
* Build reusable collections solution assets, benchmarks, discovery frameworks, playbooks, and reference architectures.
* Work with Operations to identify existing capabilities that can be productized and taken to market.
* Help shape differentiated collections propositions for target industry verticals.

  

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience across collections, recoveries, credit operations, financial services, or collections consulting.
* Strong understanding of third-party and/or first-party collections environments.
* Experience designing collections strategies or operating models at meaningful scale.
* Strong knowledge of collections KPIs including liquidation rate, cure rate, roll rate, RPC, PTP, kept PTP, contact rate, recovery rate, cost-to-collect, and agent productivity.
* Understanding of collections technology, dialers, CRM/workflow systems, payment platforms, speech analytics, and digital engagement tools.
* Working knowledge of regulatory and compliance considerations relevant to collections.
* Experience supporting large client pursuits, RFPs, consulting engagements, or transformation programs.
* Ability to translate operational problems into structured solutions and quantified business cases.
* Strong commercial orientation with the ability to balance client outcomes, operational feasibility, risk, and economics.
* Strong executive communication and presentation skills.

  

**Preferred Background**

Experience in one or more of the following would be valuable:

* Banking and consumer lending
* Credit cards
* Auto finance
* Specialty finance
* Fintech
* Utilities
* Telecom
* Healthcare receivables
* Debt purchasing
* First-party or third-party collections BPO

  

Exposure to US and/or Canadian collections environments would be particularly relevant.

  
  

**Please note: Collections experience is mandate.**

49e7b254.title: Solution Architect Voice AI
49e7b254.description:
About AgentCallBack

AgentCallBack provides enterprise Voice AI agents that manage inbound and outbound customer conversations at scale. Our multilingual AI agents operate 24/7, handle natural interruptions, remember prior interactions, transfer calls to human agents and integrate with CRM, ERP, contact-centre and telephony platforms.

We serve customers across healthcare, insurance, financial services, hospitality, retail, property management and other service-based industries.

About the Role

We are seeking a technically strong and customer-focused Solution Architect to design and deliver enterprise Voice AI solutions.

You will work closely with customers, sales, product and engineering teams to understand business requirements, design solution architecture, manage integrations and guide implementations from discovery through production deployment.

The ideal candidate understands enterprise applications, APIs, cloud platforms, telephony and conversational AI, and can translate complex technical concepts into clear business solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead technical discovery sessions with customers and document business, integration, security and operational requirements.
* Design end-to-end Voice AI solutions covering telephony, conversation workflows, integrations, data flows, security and human-agent transfers.
* Create solution architecture diagrams, integration specifications, call flows and implementation plans.
* Design integrations with CRM and ERP platforms such as Salesforce, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, JD Edwards and GoHighLevel.
* Integrate AgentCallBack with contact-centre and telephony platforms such as Genesys Cloud, 3CX, Yeastar, SIP trunks and PBX systems.
* Work with REST APIs, webhooks, authentication frameworks, data files and middleware platforms.
* Convert customer use cases into structured AI conversation flows, including escalation rules, exception handling and compliance requirements.
* Support demonstrations, proposals, technical presentations and responses to RFPs.
* Define the scope, success criteria and technical requirements for pilots and proofs of concept.
* Coordinate with engineering and product teams to configure, test and deploy customer solutions.
* Lead user acceptance testing, production readiness reviews and technical handover.
* Diagnose integration, call-quality, latency and workflow issues during implementation.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for security, scalability, reliability and data privacy.
* Identify reusable solution patterns and contribute to implementation templates and technical documentation.
* Provide technical guidance to customers, implementation partners and internal teams.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* 5–10 years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise integration, technical consulting or implementation.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication and enterprise data integration.
* Experience integrating CRM, ERP, contact-centre or customer-service applications.
* Working knowledge of SIP, VoIP, PBX systems, call routing and contact-centre technology.
* Experience designing cloud-based, scalable and secure enterprise solutions.
* Ability to create architecture diagrams, process flows, functional specifications and integration documents.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders and senior executives.
* Experience managing multiple customer implementations simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with conversational AI, Voice AI, speech recognition or generative AI solutions.
* Knowledge of large language models, prompt design, knowledge bases and conversational workflow development.
* Experience with platforms such as NetSuite, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, JD Edwards, Genesys Cloud, 3CX or GoHighLevel.
* Familiarity with AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.
* Understanding of call recording, consent, Do Not Call requirements and data-protection regulations.
* Experience working with customers across multiple countries, languages and industries.
* Previous experience in a SaaS company, systems integrator or enterprise software consulting environment.

Key Competencies

* Customer-focused problem solving
* Solution and systems thinking
* Strong technical ownership
* Clear communication and presentation
* Attention to detail
* Cross-functional collaboration
* Ability to work in a fast-moving startup environment

Success in This Role

Success will be measured by:

* Quality and scalability of proposed solutions
* Speed and effectiveness of customer implementations
* Successful completion of pilots and production deployments
* Integration reliability and call-flow accuracy
* Customer satisfaction and adoption
* Clear documentation and effective knowledge transfer

Why Join AgentCallBack?

* Work on practical enterprise applications of Voice AI.
* Design solutions across telephony, AI, CRM and ERP technologies.
* Work directly with global customers and senior decision-makers.
* Influence product capabilities and implementation standards.
* Join a growing Singapore-based technology company serving international markets.

fb39177d.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
fb39177d.description:
**Description**
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
  
  
What You'll Actually Be Doing
  
  

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

You're Our Person If...
  
  

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

f1eca248.title: Program Manager / Project Manager
f1eca248.description:
**Job Profile:**

We are seeking a passionate, technically competent, and highly driven Program Manager / Project Manager – Research & Development to lead, design, and manage our evolving sustainable technology and clean energy portfolios.

Bindi International operates on the fundamental belief that women must be at the forefront of economic and social development.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

**1. Technical Framework Design and Model Development**

● Develop comprehensive and adaptable operational blueprints, safety manuals, and playbooks for decentralized technology assembly and maintenance.

● Ensure all R&D innovations are scalable, reliable, and replicable across diverse last-mile rural contexts spanning multiple states.

● Align R&D project delivery pathways with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UNSDGs).

**2. In-House Battery Pack Production & Quality Control ("Bindi Shakti Battery")**

● Lead and optimize technical operations for the in-house battery pack assembly unit, standardizing production for five core configurations.

● Supervise quality standards, safety thresholds, and technical compliance across multiple cell chemistries:

○ NMC Configurations – 3.7V–7.8Ah cells for micro-lighting systems; 36V (7.8Ah/10Ah) battery

packs for light electric vehicles.

○ LFP Configurations – 12.8V (30Ah & 42Ah) battery packs optimized for Solar Home Systems and emergency power storage.

● Implement strict hardware validation protocols, including Internal Resistance (IR) testing, spot-welding uniformity checks, high/low voltage cutoff verification, and thermal safety cycling.

● Establish frameworks to prototype, test, and manufacture custom battery packs based on client specifications for E-Bicycles, E-Bikes, E-Scooters, and E-Rickshaws.

**3. E-Mobility Platform Integration & Optimization ("Sakthi Cycle")**

● Coordinate end-to-end engineering, Bill of Materials (BOM), and assembly workflows for the Sakthi Cycle e-mobility platform.

● Ensure component compatibility and performance integration across 250W BLDC hub motors, 36V smart controllers, 6-magnet Pedal Assist Sensors (PAS), and dual disc braking systems.

● Validate performance and safety standards in compliance with regulatory norms, including a maximum speed limit of 25 km/h and a target operational range of 40–50 km.

● Adapt high-tensile carbon steel chassis designs for rugged rural usage, optimizing heavy-duty cargo carriers, integrated lighting systems, and horn systems.

**4. Training, Capacity Building, and Field Deployment**

● Translate complex engineering specifications, wiring diagrams, and diagnostic manuals into accessible, visual training modules.

● Conduct continuous capacity-building workshops for rural women engineers to enhance their confidence and competence in electrical troubleshooting, field repairs, and hardware safety.

● Support field teams during regional pilot deployments to ensure successful implementation and long-term sustainability.

**5. Monitoring, Evaluation, and Compliance**

● Establish robust testing frameworks and product lifecycle tracking systems to monitor battery degradation, field failure rates, and product performance over time.

● Ensure all manufactured systems comply with relevant industrial certifications and standards, including IS 16045 and BIS requirements.

● Analyze field performance data to continuously refine and improve hardware engineering designs.

**6. Stakeholder Management & Documentation**

● Build and maintain strong collaborative relationships among internal execution teams, external component suppliers, B2B enterprise clients, and institutional partners.

● Maintain accurate technical records, assembly documentation, progress trackers, and case studies demonstrating technological impact on rural livelihood generation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Candidates passionate about social enterprise and women-led development models.
* Comfortable working autonomously and building operational processes from the ground up without relying on predefined corporate structures.
* Willing to relocate to or stay in Harmada (Kishangarh, Rajasthan) for the duration of the role, with flexibility to travel intermittently to remote field clusters.
* Conversational proficiency in Hindi, in addition to strong English communication skills, for effective interaction with local assembly teams.

**Key Skills and Competencies**

* Hardware Prototyping and Battery Pack Manufacturing
* Lithium-based Battery Management Systems (BMS)
* Charging Logic and Circuit Diagnostics
* Battery Safety Systems
* Renewable Energy Systems and Electric Vehicle Development
* Cross-functional Stakeholder and Vendor Management

Experience:

* 3–7 years of proven experience in hardware prototyping, battery pack manufacturing, renewable energy

systems, and electric vehicle development.

* Strong understanding of lithium-based Battery Management Systems (BMS), charging logic, circuit diagnostics, and battery safety systems.

**Qualifications:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Battery Technology, Renewable Energy Systems, Mechatronics, or a related technical field

**Location:**

The position will be based at Bindi International, Tilonia-Harmada Road, Village Harmada, District Ajmer, Rajasthan – 305812, India

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

bdcb9496.title: Senior Bid Manager
bdcb9496.description:
**Company Description**

**Work with Us. Change the World.**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**

The Senior Bid Manager is an India-based role supporting UK markets, leading the planning, management and delivery of complex and business-critical bids while supporting opportunities across the wider work winning portfolio as required.

Working in partnership with business leaders, Capture Managers, Client Account Managers and technical teams, the Senior Bid Manager is responsible for ensuring bids are delivered on time, fully compliant with client requirements and aligned with agreed win strategies.

The role provides hands-on leadership throughout the bid lifecycle, coordinating multidisciplinary contributors, managing review processes and ensuring bids are client-focused, competitive and of the highest quality.

In addition to bid leadership responsibilities, the Senior Bid Manager contributes to the development of the India-based Work Winning team through coaching, mentoring, knowledge sharing and day-to-day leadership, with greater people leadership responsibilities expected as the team expands.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Bid Leadership and Management**

* Lead the end-to-end management and delivery of complex bids.
* Develop and manage bid programmes, delivery plans, review programmes and bid activities.
* Ensure all submissions are compliant with client requirements and internal governance processes (including full adherence to ECP playbook for ECP and Tier 2 opportunities),.
* Coordinate and motivate technical, commercial, legal, quality and work winning contributors throughout the bid lifecycle.
* Lead answer planning activities and ensure clear direction is provided to contributors.
* Manage content development (including writing, formatting and graphics), reviews, approvals and final submission production.
* Maintain version control and manage document workflows throughout the bid lifecycle.
* Drive quality throughout the submission process through structured review cycles and continuous challenge.
* Monitor bid progress, identify risks and dependencies, and implement mitigation actions.
* Support interview preparation, presentation coaching and clarification responses where required.
* Conduct lessons learned reviews and support continuous improvement initiatives.

**Pursuit Strategy Support**

* Work with Capture Managers and business leaders to support pursuit planning and win strategy development.
* Facilitate workshops focused on win themes, answer planning, reviews and lessons learned.
* Help teams develop compelling value propositions and client-focused messaging.
* Support commercial and technical workstreams to ensure coherent and differentiated submissions.
* Maintain alignment between pursuit strategy and bid content.

**Team Leadership and Development**

* Act as a senior member of the India-based Work Winning team supporting UK markets.
* Coach and mentor Bid Managers, Bid Coordinators and developing work winning professionals.
* Support onboarding and integration of new team members.
* Contribute to a positive, collaborative and high-performing team culture.
* Share best practices, lessons learned and work winning knowledge across the team to drive continuous improvement.
* Support capability-building initiatives led by Associate Bid Directors and UK leadership.
* Take on increasing people leadership responsibilities as the India-based team expands.

**Stakeholder Management and Communication**

* Build effective working relationships with UK business leaders, technical teams and pursuit stakeholders.
* Provide clear and consistent communication on bid progress, risks and actions.
* Facilitate alignment across geographically dispersed pursuit teams.
* Act as a trusted work winning partner, supporting teams to achieve successful outcomes.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Project Management, Engineering, or related discipline
* Minimum 7 years' experience in bid management, proposal management, or related work-winning functions
* Minimum 3 years' experience in a senior or lead bid management role, demonstrating hands-on leadership of complex, multi-stakeholder pursuits
* Proven experience managing end-to-end bid lifecycles for business-critical opportunities, from capture through submission and post-bid activities
* Demonstrated experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams across geographies, including technical, commercial, legal and quality contributors
* Experience developing and implementing bid strategies, win themes and value propositions aligned with client requirements
* Track record of delivering compliant, high-quality submissions within tight deadlines

  
**Additional Information**

**Key Attributes**

* Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of complex pursuits in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish credibility, trust and influence stakeholders remotely across geographies, cultures and business functions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of communicating clearly and confidently with senior leaders, technical specialists and pursuit teams.
* Highly collaborative, with a team-first mindset and the ability to bring together diverse stakeholders to achieve shared objectives.
* Strong attention to detail, ensuring high standards of quality, accuracy, compliance and consistency across all deliverables.
* Well organised and able to manage multiple priorities, competing deadlines and changing business requirements.
* Strong facilitation skills, capable of leading workshops, discussions and reviews that result in clear actions and outcomes.
* Effective problem solver who can identify risks, anticipate challenges and implement practical solutions.
* Adaptable and resilient, maintaining focus and professionalism during periods of pressure and ambiguity.
* Committed to continuous improvement, seeking opportunities to enhance bid quality, team capability and pursuit outcomes.
* Demonstrates sound judgement and accountability, making informed decisions and following through on commitments.
* Invested in the success and development of others, actively sharing knowledge, coaching colleagues and contributing to a positive team culture.
* Strong project management discipline with the ability to coordinate complex bid activities and maintain momentum across multidisciplinary teams.
* Sound working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Work, Powerpoint and Adobe InDesign.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

**About AECOM**

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, and service recognition awards.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
